text:
I have been going to Mimosa for waxing for a few years now. I have always had a good experience and left a happy customer!

I was in over the weekend for a wax and realized the next day that there was still some hair left behind, so I left a voicemail with the issue on a day they were closed. 
I was pleased when they contacted me bright and early the next business day, and promptly got me in for a touch-up wax, free of charge.

Very pleased with how they handled the situation, I will continue going there for years to come!
Even if they forgot the extra seasoning for my rings, the staff members who run this place are tops.  They work hard and they keep the place acceptably tidy.  Recommended for a grease feast.

I used too go to this spa yrs ago but i decided to try others so saying that i am going back for a spring pedi soon as they are friendl and do not rush you so when you leave you do feel relax.
I hope Jen is still there as she used to do my pedi

I have tried many Vietnamese places but this is by far my favourite.  If you are looking for a cheap bowl of pho or a noodle bowl look no further.  No, the tables don't get cleared right away, but we are in and out of there in less than 45 mins (usually 30!) even if the place is  packed.  #11, 22 and 44 are our favourites and you can't go wrong with the green onion cakes. Never paid more than $30 for a meal for two of us, and the tea is free!
This place serves up dreck.  I don't know what these other Yelp users see in it.  From flat, largely flavourless pho to hard uninspired spring rolls, the food at Pho Anh Sang is not good.

We visit this location fairly regularly, probably once every six weeks or so.

Food has always been consistent, the pizza good, service usually fine but sometimes a bit on the slow side. We've never had a bad experience here and always enjoyed everything we've ordered, from appies to pasta dishes to pizzas. Free wifi is a bonus!

I am more impressed with this location each time I go! Maybe I am getting to understand the layout but it seems like the selection and stock are improving. 

Price checking is always a good option but sometimes Canadian Tire just drops their prices and that is when it is time to pounce. Momma likes her deals so I usually shop off season and have a pretty good personal inventory idea of what I need/want and what I don't. 

As far as Automotive goes I have asked a few ordering questions and as per usual with Canadian Tire this department does not receive great reviews from me...or anyone I know. If given the choice on that I may even consider running past the local high school shop class before I walk in here as a female.

Drayden is located basically on the trail which is handy. Also being open late on Thursday and Saturdays which is also nice. The staff is all friendly and having a registries office is awesome. My broker Chelsea works hard to make sure I am getting the best deal I can. I have been with a few insurance companies and I can say Drayden is great!

I assume this is the BP we get delivery from. Which is always amazing! I admit they are a few $$ more but in the end they are my fav. pizza delivery place. Prompt and tasty. Lunch wasn't that great. The service was good. I mean not amazing. I did ask for a second to pick a drink but it did take a few minutes. The ceaser I had was great though. While the ribs were tasty the size was tiny. Overall it was a decent lunch but I wish I had stuck to the pizza or pasta I know is always good there. It is the delivery that gives this place a 4/5 in the end!

I just called for a quote on a part for my vehicle, and received horrible customer service. They were extremely rude and treated me like I was an idiot. I felt stupid after hanging up the phone and definitely won't be taking my car there. Canadian tire should hire nicer employees in their service department. Not impressed.

Gave this place a try after being disappointed with another Vietnamese restaurant in St. Albert.

We were pleasantly surprised to find it busy on a weekday and the menu had a lot of variety including a kids option for Pho with meatballs, brisket, and no scallion and beverage for $5!  We opted for plain wonton soup for our toddler, but none the less impressive!

My husband had the adult version of the Pho with meatballs and brisket - the large was under $8.  I had the vermicelli bowl with steak, shrimp, and spring rolls which was $10.

The fish sauce was seasoned nicely and I appreciated the 3 options of hot sauce on our table in addition to hoisson sauce.

I enjoyed everything except the shrimp... next time, I'll just order the steak and spring roll vermicelli for $2 less - $8 (a great price!).

Everything tasted fresh and full of flavor.

The one thing I didn't like... I asked for a half cup of rice for my toddler to have with her bowl of wont ton soup... and we were charged $2.00 for 10 cents worth of rice.  

I did notice that their menu had bubble tea!  We ran out of time on this particular visit but I look forward to trying their bubble tea next time!  There was an entire page of specialty drinks at the back of the menu - smoothies, shakes, pearl tea, etc.

We will definitely return again - although, I'll skip the $2.00 1/2 cup of plain white rice, lol!

I was going to give it one star but decided 2 stars is fine. For the most part I get what I ordered, except when I don't but I've already paid for it and have been waiting for 10 minutes only to find out they don't have the thing I wanted. 

I find it is not bad going through the drive through but inside you will be waiting a minimum of 5 minutes for any beverage. Just one beverage. This isn't all staff it is 2 in particular. I hate to speak ill of anyone in particular so all I will say is if you are in no rush and like to talk this is the time for you. If you want coffee in a reasonable time at all don't come here, especially if you are getting more than coffee.

This is a full tims hortons shared with the Esso. The Esso is fast and efficient. Just not the tims.

We stopped here a couple weeks ago to have dinner during the week.  The lady that seated us was rude and seemed inconvenienced when we asked for water and tea.  She went into the back and was loudly talking in vietnamese to the cook, almost yelling at him.  The restaurant seemed dirty and the food was bland with no flavor, just noodles and very few vegetables.  When we asked for the bill, the lady again appeared annoyed to be asked for something.  I dont think will ever return here.  There is alot of other options for Vietnamese food in St.Albert.

Was ok. Not terrible; not bad. But ok. It's a dingy hole in the wall that certainly isn't focused on decor or tidiness but the owner who served us was pleasant and prompt. 
If you're at this stripmall and hungry NOW, don't hesitate. But if you've got time to shop around and looking for something extra to your dining experience I think I'd go somewhere else.

I was given a gift certificate for The Rock and was excited to use it for a cut and color.  I had a senior stylist for the color and a junior stylist for the cut.  The senior stylist seemed crusty and annoyed right off the bat.  She made no attempt to converse except to ask me if I rented or had my own house in St. Albert.  She quoted me $119 to $129 absolute max (her words).  I wondered why my shoulder length hair was going to be $30-$40 over the minimum for color on the website ($89) but thought I'm already here.  The color turned out to be much darker than the sample I had picked (it was almost black, which is my normal hair color).  For the cut, the stylist was quite friendly and sweet but my side swept bangs did not turn out anything like the pictures I had shown her.  When I went to pay, the total came to $193.  I asked the lady how much I was charged for the color and she responded $139.  I told her that the stylist quoted max $129.  She was reluctant to change the price stating that she probably had to use more color.  When I wouldn't accept, she finally went back to ask the stylist and she was like "oh yeah, charge her $129."  She made no attempt to apologize.  I will never go to this place again.....way overpriced for what you get, some stylists are not that friendly and I felt scammed!

First time here, heard about there roast beef dinner. Was not impressed! Not real mahed potatoes and they  hide stuffing under the roast beef to make it look like a lot of roat beef. Beef also vety thinly sliced.

I went into today to get breakfast. The hash browns were not only cold and soggy but when I asked to get the shredded ones instead it took nearly 10 minutes to bring the new ones out and they were also under cooked and soggy looking. Couldn't eat my food at all. They charged me for everything. The service was mostly poor. Usually I come in and we get Rowena and she's an amazing server.  Next time we come in if she's not there we will walk right back out. Terrible food. Terrible service.

The fun part of a manicure and pedicure is trying out different nail polish colors. Unfortunately, many of the nail polish bottles here looked half to almost empty. This was a bummer. I noticed my nail polish selection was based on the amount available in the bottles versus my initial color preferences. Next to the till, there were plenty of brand new nail polish bottles to buy. However, I don't usually buy nail polish bottles at the salon. 

The lady who did my pedicure was nice. The pedicure tools looked like they were sanitized and clean. The manicure and pedicure set up looked pretty average. However, my main concern and turnoff here was an obvious breach in cleanliness that I witnessed. 

The lady who did my pedicure put on latex gloves prior to handling my feet. While my toenails were drying she was helping another customer pay at the till. I was grossed out by the fact she was still using the gloves she wore helping me! She handled the debit/credit machine while wearing the gloves. I know those machines aren't clean as a baseline but still! I think some people feel a false sense of cleanliness when they wear gloves. What other breaches in sanitation are happening here?

You need to wash your hands with soap and water before and after using gloves! Hand hygiene is especially important in a place where you're handling a large number of hands and feet. People don't want to get infections! We need reassurance that we're in a clean environment. 

I won't be back here and I don't recommend it.
Stopped here for breakfast. Perfect eggs. Excellent toast. Awesome value for the money. I have heard that the A & W breakfast is amazing and I can attest that it's true !

As good as it gets for A&W's. Though they are pretty consistent this St Albert location is consistently very good. Always have liked A&W Root Beer and the burgers, even the Chubby Chicken is pretty god but you usually have to wait. 

The St Albert location has a lot of Philipino workers and they provide great service. Will be interesting to see what happens when they go back home.

MY BIG COMPLAINT with A&W is that ever since they switched to the New York style fries I HATE the flavor of them. Go back to a McDonald's style fry, it is the only reason anyone eats lunch at Micky upchuck's to start with. Why loose business to them just because your fries are terrible.

There was a bit of a line today though we were served quickly.

Mona helped us today.  She was in a grumpy mood and seemed more interested in shoving customers through the queue than being pleasant.

Mona was even less impressive when I went back to collect the receipt that should have been offered but was not given.

The Stony Plain office is much more friendly to work with.

I eat here once a week but that might increase once winter hits. Nothing's better then a warm bowl of Pho on a cold night. 

This place is authentic Vietnamese cuisine that's best in St Albert. I prefer the Pho or the Vermicelli bowl over their rice dishes. I still haven't had their salad rolls but the spring rolls have a nice crunch but leave a little to be desired. 

I usually don't have room after dinner but I really enjoy Vietnamese iced coffees and they do it exactly how I like it.

I haven't seen any Nam-wiches on their menu and I wish there were cuz they are quite tasty and normally well priced.

I happened to be in the area and decided to try out this restaurant for a quick lunch. Reviews on Yelp were mixed on food quality but consistent on service quality. 

I hesitated to try but needed to get back to the office so I decided to give it a try. 

Well, this appears to be a classic family run restaurant. Service was not what I would expect in Canada, but consistent with my experiences having meals at similar places in Asia.  Do not expect hellos on your way in, prompt checking in, and even the simpler things like having your meal placed out in front of you by the waiter - they just silently slide it on the side of the table for you to reposition all on your own. 

I'm less fussed about these things and was more interested in the quality of the food.  How was it?

Well, bland.  Flavourless pho with very skimpy meat portions along with very dry and tasteless spring rolls.  A disappointment. 

I probably won't come back given the many other Vietnamese options in St. Albert.

I have actually been to this location once.  Two other times no one has answered and after leaving a message I've had to call back after hours of waiting.
Don't think I'll return if this is their Customer SERVICE policy.

This Ricky's is very bright and spacious. The staff seemed very friendly and willing to accommodate modifications to menu items. I was having breakfast for lunch, and wanted an egg and perogy platter substituting an order of hash browns for the sausage. No problem. My dining companion wanted something substantial, and had the roast beef dinner. 

Both of us enjoyed our meals. My eggs were done to order, the perogies were delicious, and I got my hash browns. The roast beef seemed like a generous portion, and the accompanying veggies and mashed potatoes got rave reviews (even though to me they did not look like anything special). 

The menu is extremely varied almost to the point of having too many choices. However, that is not a complaint. I like a place where I can go and find something to suit my taste no matter what time of day.

This location used to be very good. i'm not sure what happened, but the service and quality of the food has dropped dramatically. I started to notice in the last six months that food and service were getting worse and worse.  the last (and final) time we went there for breakfast we waited over 45 minutes for two orders of pancakes and eggs. My eggs came out ice cold and at first glance I thought it was a plastic egg. Took me close to ten minutes to flag down a waitress whom all but asked me what she should do about it.  I had to ask for them to take it off my bill.  Terrible. Such a shame as this used to be a great spot.

Arrived at noon and found the parking lot packed but the restaurant pleasantly spacious.

We ordered one of their new pizzas - the Meat Overload and was pleasantly surprised by both the flavour, variety, and amount of meat.  I'm not usually a meaty kind of girl but hubby was super excited to try this one!  I like the crust - chewy but light and the sauce was flavourful!

My toddler had a kids' meal of chicken strips with steamed veggies for a side and there are onions in the veggies - BIG THUMBS DOWN!  What toddler likes steamed red onions in their veggies!  Also - the dessert options with her kids meal were truly odd - my daughter chose the chocolate pizza which turned out to be a little chocolate in the shape of a pizza (think chocolate coin) - not what I expect at a restaurant.  Perhaps pictures of the options would be helpful.  I mean - they didn't even offer a small scoop of ice cream as an option for the kids dessert and how much could that really cost them?  

They would get 4 stars for the pizza but 2 stars on the toddler meal so it averages out to 3 stars for my overall review.

Service was a bit slow - I inquired about eggs in the meatballs because my baby has an egg allergy and it took nearly 10 minutes for the server to get back to me.  At first she said there wouldn't be eggs in meatballs but I asked her to check with the chef anyway, and sure enough, their ingredient book listed it - not too surprising as eggs are frequently used as a binding agent.

Hubby and I shared the Sticky Toffee Pudding for dessert which was delicious but the ice cream scoop on top amounted to maybe 5-6 spoonfuls - quite pitiful.  The Sticky Toffee itself was yummy but we could have used a little more ice cream.

As a side note, I took my daughter to the women's washroom which smelled atrocious!  Whatever chemical they used in there smelled like a freaking urine cake - I seriously wanted to vomit.

So I'm left 50/50 on this one - Pizza was quite good, toddler meal was disappointing, and dessert was good but needed more ice cream.  We would have liked to order the special of the day for an appetizer (1/2 price wings) but it was quite difficult getting our server's attention for normal things like napkins and water refills so we never did get to order the Wings not that we needed any more food!  Between the two of us we only ate 1/2 the large pizza.

I think we will try them again but without a kid or two in tow.

I uploaded pics of the pizza!  (And I did her another patron talking with the manager inquiring as to why the Wi-Fi wasn't working and the manager noted they had been having difficulty with it lately).
Improperly trained staff. They do not use gel approved for gel nails they used a cheeper version not approved. Rushed in and out. You get what you pay for here. Cheep.

This Tim's location has removed all their garbage containers for the drive thru and now our neighbourhood is filled with Tim Horton's coffee cups. Very bad neighbour to have with so much garbage blowing around and they don't care at all. I tried to speak with them on several occasions with zero response. Now I choose to drive to the other locations and plan my trips out to include other Tim's locations that are better business people and environmentally responsible. I would always over look that my order was never right. My daughter and I would always joke about what they could get wrong with our orders until they would charge us for bacon that was never on the sandwich and stopped thinking it was funny that the orders were so far off of what we ordered. My husband has now started to go to McDonald's for their coffee as it is cheaper and more flavour. We stopped purchasing gas at this location also. It is all we can do as consumers is to not give them our business and to not reward bad behaviour.

I was here for lunch and the drive-thru and line inside was so busy.  There was only one person taking orders for inside and it took 15 minutes.  The food at A&W is always good but when the service sucks, it's not worth the wait!  Not sure if they only have one person working at lunch all the time since it was my first time here.

For the longest time, I never even thought about trying Ricky's. I try to eat local over chains, and I prefer interesting cuisines over the same ol' burger and fries.

I can't attest to the burger and fries style meals that make up the dinner menu, but what surprised me is their fantastic all day brunch! And not just on Saturdays or Sundays - no, no. Breakfast till 4 PM, 7 days a week. What is that? That's awesome.

When Socrates down the road gets full, it turns out that this is your best option for a delicious breakfast out with friends or family. This place gets pretty busy, too, and it seems to host way more families than Socrates does. Lots of high chairs.

There isn't anything too crazy on the menu - omelettes, pancakes, waffles, bennies, french toast. But one cool thing - the classic double egger breakfast comes with your choice of bavarian, chorizo or calabrese sausage. (I personally love the chorizo because it has a bit of a kick!) That's some pretty cool bonus for a big chain restaurant with average decor and average service. Oh, and if you're into it, order a side of perogies! Because it's never too early for perogies.

I have lived in St. Albert for 8 years now and have enjoyed many a meal from here. One of my favorite menu items is the Bun 5 Mau. It is a Vermicelli bowl that has Julienne Pork, Meat Ball, Fried Roll, Grilled Pork, & Grilled Chicken. I find the service to be good here and prompt. My wife usually gets the chicken Pho and she really enjoys it. My kids get the brisket with noodles kids meal with no soup and they love it. We sometime also get the green onion cakes too and they are ok ..  nothing to rave about. My family enjoys the food from here and we love to support local St. Albert business!

No car service or battery purchase here, it's actually worse than some of the car dealerships' service departments. They didn't know how to get the battery out of my 2000 Chrysler Sebring convertible and spent hours messing with it; the steering needed to be turned all the way to access the battery behind the wheel. They make you get an electrical system test report for ~ $45 at your cost every time you make a claim to replace a battery under their 9 year warranty, which never makes it past 3 years, maybe less.

Wait staff doesn't appear to have any interest in customer service. They communicate with a series of grunts or one word responses, and will not be there to check in on you.  If you want a water refill, you'll need to go and wait at the front until somebody notices you to ask for it. Doesn't appear to be the most hygienic place either. That being said, the pho is always really tasty and the price is very decent for the portion size you get. Take out is a better option.

Just moved to the area and we are definitely coming back to this one, got the chicken Memphis burger and it was a serious explosion of flavor in my mouth. The fish bowl Friday is a no brainer and never had a problem with the service any time we went . Other thing worth bringing up is one of the waitresses hair color, it's kinda like if you're at the shooting range and they have these blitzeballs filled with different colored sand. Just wanting to clarify I'm not moaning or complaining about it at all, it just got a double take out of me haha. Any way cliff notes food is delicious , drinks go down easy so please take a cab on Friday if you have to. Keep your stick on the ice
With 3 kids always can count on a good meal and a place where if the kids get a little rowdy they just fit in not drive others crazy!!!
Not a bad little place to eat, but was a little let down by the portion sizes. Ordered grilled chicken and I got such a small portion.

Unfortunately I have to agree with many of the reviews posted here. I love pho and was hoping this could be my hometown go to. I actually thought the pho was decent, not great and not awful... but the level of cleanliness (or lack thereof) in this establishment made my fiancé finally say we were done here after a few visits. The service is bad, and our final visit saw every unoccupied table in the place full of dirty dishes. There was food on the floor, and the owner (who was obviously sick with a cold) sat behind the cash register loudly hacking, coughing and sucking snot as we ate. As stated before, were done here and won't return.
Good family restaurant.Menu a bit dated in this vegan health food era.Still a few miles left in the tank.

I'm going to update my review on this location and up it to 4 stars.

Both myself and Gramma have been taking the kids here pretty regularly.

The kids are always happy with their regular kiddo meals (plain burgers and cheese pizza with only pineapple).

We've certainly had some misses here in the past but our most recent visits have been great. 

Servie has been attentive with drinks refilled timely (which I truly appreciate) and their most recent addition to the pizza menu is absolutely delicious - the Viva!  it's spicy with a kick that pairs wonderfully with the Ginger Quencher.  

It's also nice that as you get to know the servers they remember what you like here.

We'll be seeing you again soon!

Ricky's has never been my first choice for anything.  But if somebody else wants to go there, I don't complain.  I have one important question though....

WHY IS IT SO HOT IN HERE?!  I had to go outside to get some air half way through my meal.

Food is mostly bland and uninteresting, and service is pretty lackluster.  Or completely over the top... depending on who you get.

My husband and I go to Ricky's on a regular basis for brunch.  I always have the Classic Eggs Benedict and he always has the steak and eggs.  The service is always great.  We do have to wait a bit longer on the busier Sundays, but normally we are greeted and served right away.  I would give Ricky's five stars, but I have found that when I order my eggs medium they tend to come out runny.  There have been a few times when my shredded potatoes have been soggy and not crisp.  My husband never has a complaint though!  All in all a good place for everyone at a reasonable price.

Normally good service, but the last time I went (a month ago) the stylist did not listen to my concerns about where and how much I wanted blonded. Now, I am noticing on the back of my head, nothing was done. I have never been more disappointed in the Rock and am following up this concern with them. I want to remain a loyal customer, but I pay too much money there to have only a partial hair blonding done.
I do recommend The Rock, but be careful.

Went there for their BBQ chicken pizza. We added pineapple as an extra topping. We enjoy this pizza and have had it before. We also decided to try the chicken pizza with Alfredo sauce, which we also enjoyed. We had two small pizzas and one tea  - which cost around $50! We like the pizza, but it is far too pricy for what we were getting therefore we hesitate to return.

I had a body wrap and a facial done by Joyce. It was one of the most amazing and relaxing facials ever! The body wrap was good too, that was just something I wanted to try, but I'm raving over that facial! This was a Groupon deal so I got a great deal too, I will go back and pay full price

I got my hair and makeup done here for my sister's wedding in the summer. I received a lot of compliments! The hair stylist and makeup artist both listened to my concerns due to my sensitive skin. 

The only thing I found a bit odd was that they didn't have any waterproof mascara. They do weddings all the time, it's usually a safe bet to have some on hand because one never knows. 

Everyone in the bridal party looked amazing - especially my sister. They did some funky design with her hair incorporating the veil which looked really cool. 

They were great putting up with a bunch of excited women snapping photos and such. They generously offered coffee which I truly appreciated considering that I'm not a morning person and it was that time of day. 

I'd certainly recommend making an appointment because this is a busy spot.

I brought my best friend to Ricky's for a late Sunday lunch. 

While the food was excellent for what you would expect from a chain restaurant, we were sorely disappointed with the service. After being initially served and brought our food, our waitress did not check on us at all. Our drinks were empty, she did not get back to us on whether or not our desired dessert was available, and did not bring us our bill. 

After sitting there for 30 minutes without any service, we started motioning to other staff to come help us. We were completely ignored, which was baffling because there were only one or two tables occupied and there were more than just one server.

After awhile, a different waitress came along with our bill. I asked for a couple of take out containers for our food, and she never returned.

We sat there for almost twenty minutes before I decided to wrap my sandwich in a napkin and leave.

We paid for our meals, and did not tip. I always tip, I know what it means to be tipped, but being ignored for almost an hour in total doesn't beget any gratuities.  

I will never return to this lack lustre location.

Had a great experience today...very friendly staff who work together to ensure you have a relaxing visit.  Saw Tricia for a haircut...she was sure to check what I was looking for and delivered a great look for me!  the price was very reasonable at under $50 but will be more if you see a master stylist.  I loved the scalp massage before my haircut too!  They have some great Valentine's Day offers if you are looking for a great gift...massages, facials, couples pedi (you can bring wine--they will supply glasses).

The Rock knows hair. 

I've been seeing Lisa at the Rock for the past 5 years, even though I've been living outside of St. Albert for most of that time (that's how good they are here, folks).

Though the outside of the building looks like a leftover set from a Flintstones live-action movie, the interior has a very open and relaxed feel and the ceiling looks like it's plastered with icing. Seriously. Look up next time you're there. It'll kick your sweet tooth into high gear. 

The girls at the reception desk are friendly and offer you coffee/tea/the moon while you wait for your appointment. There are plenty of hair & beauty mags to leaf through for some last-minute inspiration.

All salon services start with a free stress-relieving head & neck massage (as is custom with most Aveda salons). In my experience, the stylists have all been attentive, friendly, and efficient - and their work is excellent. They know how to cut hair in such a way that it not only looks gorgeous in the salon, but also after you wash it and even as it grows out. 

The prices are on the higher end of the scale (especially if you see a senior stylist), but considering the quality of the cut and the excellent service, the prices are very fair. 

I can't personally vouch for the other services offered here (colour, facials, massages), but I did buy my mum a massage package for Mother's Day a couple years ago and she loved it. 

I can't say enough good things about this place - The Rock is solid. (Ha!)

My family loves Ricky's, it's decent food for a reasonable price. I enjoyed many of their entrees and it is a nice family environment. They did miss the temp on my steak by a lot the one time I ordered one, but the service and comfort allow me to forgive them this one time.
Great coffee, great service!  The food is a bit bland (I had the eggs Benedict) but the coffee refills kept coming so that definitely made up for it.

Love this Canadian Tire location. It's near my home and Yesterday I bought a keurig single coffee maker. Have not been in since  July ish, and they have redone the store! The layout has been changed so when on automatic pilot you may end up in the wrong isle like I did.lol they moved the pet care section. But it looks bigger, cleaner, brighter. I like the change.
The cashier was fast like usual. :)

I went here to have my Shellac removed off my toes and get a pedicure. The girl did my toes was nice enough..but when she was using the drill to remove the shellac it was very painful. She kept getting the skin around my toes rather then just the nail itself. I kept flinching in pain and saying that it was painful, "could she be careful not to get the drill on my skin"..etc..but ya she kept on doing it. Wasn't fun..lemme tell ya..

That all being said..the pedicure was good. My toes look very cute, and I like the outcome..just not crazy about what happened before the cute feet!

Love this location. Usually visit for breakfast or lunch and we are very rarely disappointed. The food and service is great and the value for your dollar is good. I recommend the clubhouse or the works omelette.
Ordered buggers and they totally f ____   ked up the order will never return.maybe  check the order and make sure it's correct

I went and got new sets of acrylics and i was there for 2 1/2 hours. The first girl who did my nails took an hour & a half but she messed up with gluing my nails so it cracked but she still kept going and just added more glue to my nails, so another lady took over and fixed it but this lady was very harsh and was not careful. When you sit down everyone stares at you and are talking in their language and it seems like they are all laughing at you because they are all staring and laughing. Also the next day my nails started to crack and the nails are uneven. I would not recommend going to this place if you are looking for a new nail place.

I love this location...because it is within walking distance to my home. The idea of having an amenity like that was almost enough to define location location location when it came to house buying for me. 

The seating, service and selection are enough for even the infrequent visitor. I often see semi trucks, elderly and young families here as it has such a central setting for the Servus Centre, adult living and Campbell Business park. 

Give this Tim's a try here as it is busy enough to keep the snacks and coffee fresh! The staff goes above and beyond each time and have fixed a mistake that happened the day before or given me a free coffee when I am scrambling with my wallet and appeared stressed...that kind of service can change a persons mind frame for the day!

This is probably the worst Tim Hortons I've ever been to. Everytime I order timbits, and I make sure I say ASSORTED, I get two kinds only, the shitty powder ones and the nasty pancake ones. I know there's other flavours, why are you giving 5 each of two kinds? You're already the slowest people on the planet. Now you're so lazy you just grab handfuls of one kind and throw it in the box. I honestly don't get how you guys can be this fuckin bad. Bad enough English proficiency isn't a job requirement.

I like this location. Service is good, usually pretty knowledgeable and thye almost always have sale items in stock. Only service work I have ever had done here was new tires mounted and balanced, and you can't beat CT's prices on Goodyear Duratrac tires. Way cheaper than Fountain Tire for the exact same tire. The 97 ST location is the exact opposite, terrible service and lousy attitude. Bad enough when you are buying something there, returning anything they make into a real ordeal, if they were the only CT I would never shop CT again.

Tried breakfast here with my husband for the first time a little while ago.  I found their prices to be a little on the higher side for breakfast but the menu selections and quality were great. 

I took a peek at the rest of their menu and there definitely were items I would like to come back and try.

The thing I enjoyed most about this location was the modern and clean atmosphere.  The service was attentive but not overbearing. 

We will most definitely return.

I live in St. Albert, and if I can avoid going to Edmonton for food I try to. There are a couple Vietnamese places in St. Albert, and Pho Anh Sang is one of them. 

Its a hole in the wall restaurant tucked into a mini-mall just off Mckenney ave. The decor is barren and basic but I love it. It is family run, the food is cheap, fresh and fast.

I don't eat very often in St. Albert but I was in the area after a soccer tournament and a bunch of my teammates and I were craving in pho. Someone suggested Pho Anh Sang so we went there to satisfy our pho cravings. 

Place is your typical Vietnamese restaurant - couple tables, bare and simplistic. Who cares though? As long as the food is good, I'm happy! So to the food, we ordered a couple of appetizers to share and each our own vermicilli noodles/bowls of pho. I'll just tell you what I had/tasted.

- Fried spring rolls ($4) - you get four and comes with dipping sauce. Crunchy. Decent but nothing that you can't get elsewhere.
- Fresh rolls ($4) - you get two rolls cut into four pieces. I like these more but maybe I'm just biased in general?
- Pho ga ($9 for large) - tasty simple broth. Good amount of noodles and comes with the usual sides.

I didn't have it but the vietnamese ice coffee ($3-4) looked really good. They put it through one of those mini sifters, then you mix it with the condensed milk at the bottom of your cup and then pour it into a cup with ice. I don't drink coffee but this looked delicious! Same for their mango bubble tea ($4). YUM.

Good Vietnamese place in St. Albert if your craving pho or something cheap and delicious. Give it a try. They even accept cards surprisingly!

The food here is not freshly prepared and very mediocre. Vermicelli bowl arrived too quickly for the meats to have been freshly cooked. The chicken and prawns were dry and the lettuce and veg were sparse and also not fresh. The biggest issue is the cleanliness. Very dirty everywhere. Bathrooms are filthy. Clutter is piled up. If the areas customers see are in that condition, I can only imagine the state of the kitchen. Would not recommend eating here. Ever.

Avoid this place at all costs. My gel manicure chipped after one day and completely ruined my nails. I have had gel manicures numerous times, and this place uses a comparatively absurd approach in which they smooth our your natural nail with a drill. This makes life easier for the technician, but removes way too much nail, making them weak and brittle. I was also unimpressed with the hygiene here. Technicians definitely recycled files from person to person, and there was not much cleaning going on. Skip it.

Absolutely wonderful massage... She worked out all of my stress and tension and I came in like a knot and walked out so relaxed.!! Super friendly very clean. Wonderful! 

The only negative, it wasn't quiet. There was a person there doing a skin lesson and I heard the majority of her presentation through the peaceful sounds being played in the room. 

An UPDATED review... The wonderful owner Holly, saw my review on yelp and called me apologizing for the presentation being done (which typically doesn't happen during the time of people getting  massages. ) She was absolutely courteous and wonderful and offered me a free make up massage to get the true spa experience... Highly highly recommend this spa.  THANK YOU!

I don't usually head to St. Albert for pho, but I had to be there for business reasons on such a cold and snowy day that I was craving a bowl of Vietnamese noodle soup badly. Pho Anh Sang is one of the handful of Vietnamese restaurants in St. Albert and was reasonably close to where we had to be, so we ventured there for lunch.

The interior looked pretty much like most of the pho places I have been - plain tables and chairs with no-frills as far as decorating goes. Menu choices and prices are also in line with other Vietnamese restaurants. Bowls of pho will run you six or seven dollars depending on size, vermicelli bowls around seven or eight, and there is a variety of other dishes incorporating meat and noodles. 

We started off with an order of onion cakes. They were served hot and crispy in a basket, without being greasy. A couple of plates would have been nice, but otherwise the cakes were quite enjoyable.

Of course, I had a small bowl of Pho Tai (medium steak). It was piping hot from start to finish, had a decent amount of meat and noodles, and a good tasting broth. I wasn't blown away by any one element of the soup, but it certainly hit the spot.

He had a grilled chicken vermicelli bowl. I tasted a small piece of chicken and it was good, and he was overall happy with his meal. To me, the bowl seemed small, but with a final bill that was only around $20 before the tip, it was economical.

If I am in St. Albert and crave pho, I will definitely head back to Pho Anh Sang and I recommend others do the same.

I'm a fan of delivery. I usually order in the rack of ribs and prime rib burger, and usually a meteor pizza. The pizzas are pricey by current standards. The nooner pizza special until 3 PM is a good deal though, especially with 4 toppings. You can collect air miles and get food using gift cards purchased with air miles.

I'd never use them for their car services but they do have great sales on their tools and gadgets. My recent purchases have included: lump charcoal for a BBQ, coolers for camping, a leather man multi purpose tool, and a dry bag for tubing. Oh ya, the tube too. Lol 

I never remember my Canadian tire money but that's not their fault I guess.

Terrible service department.... I took my car for an out of province inspection. I was warned to avoid All Canadian Tire shops for inspections as they tend to make up bogus issues to increase their billing. Apparently all Canadian Tire stores compete with each other on who sells the most.... Great short term thinking! My car is a 2015 bmw with 40 thousand km and bmw factory warranty for another year. This warranty includes oil changes and brakes. They wanted me to get 3500.00$ of repairs done including new brakes and rotors, which were changed a month ago. Complete crooks.... they are essentially thieves. I plan on reporting them. I had an inspection done at a shop that only does inspections and the car passed the safety on the same day.

So far I have really enjoyed this spa. I haven't yet had the privelege of getting anything but massages (student budget) but I will rave about Molly, one of the massage therapists. I have seen 5 other RMT's in the past three years but she is by far the best for working out knotts and for total relaxation.

I will soon be able to enjoy their pedis and facials; I've heard nothing but good things! I will review as I experience them:-)

Well I won't go through my entire story of going there..but I'll just give the highlights:

I was the first appointment of the day and they all showed up and opened 15 min late. When they did finally open up they had a huge argument with each other (in Chinese I am assuming). So it was majorly awkward to be standing there..no one took my coat, no one even greeted me, they just let me in and started yelling at each other in a language I couldn't understand. 

They refused to get the drill out to remove the old gel (from an old set of gel nails)..I asked if she would take off this little wee bit of gel left over and all she would say was "No, but I'd have to get the drill out"..I mean jeez its a nail salon!!

And I got a horrible case of athletes foot from them not cleaning their tools between customers :( Its completely filthy!

Boston Pizza is the place I go when I'm wanting a meal at a familiar place.  I can dine at pretty much any Boston Pizza and know what I'm getting.  I've had very few real disapppointments.  This one delivered.

We were looking for a quick lunch near our hotel and this suited us. I had the wings, two others had the french onion soup and the fourth in our party had the soup of the day, some sort of tomamto and pasta.  We were all pleased with our meals.

Service was fast and friendly. There was, however, a party in the "party room" that was beyond anything I've experinced for noise level. As a reflection on the restaurant, the walls of the party room do not reach the ceiling so are rather pointless, as well, the door was not closed so any sound barrier the walls might have provided was lost.

As a reflection of the adults who were part of this mostly children party, shame on you.  It seemed this was some sort of a sports team celebrating a victory.  I can appretiate that the kids were excited and happy but many were literally screaming throughout the meal with no control from the adults.  Our server apologized but there wasn't much could be done about it I suppose.

My favorite spa :)  The pedicures are always relaxing, gorgeous and last a long time but more importantly, they have the best massage therapist I've ever been to (and I've been to a lot!)  Hadeal is very smart, makes customers feel comfortable and gives the most relaxing massages ever.  She has also helped my back pain more than any other professional I've been to.  Would definitely recommend.

If you have money to burn, this is the salon for you! I received fantastic highlights from one of their lovely junior stylists the other day. I reviewed the price of $119+ online before booking and figured, with all my hair (thick shoulder length) I would be looking at $180 without a cut. After running late for time, I opted to skip the blow dry/style as my husband was waiting outside with our 3 little kids.  I stopped up front to pay and the receptionist casual said it would be $258 plus tax and tip. Wait, what?  $258 for a soaking wet, uncut head of highlights??? For reference, I had just been to Hair FX (highly recommend, btw) in May for cut, color, highlights, blow dry and style for $145 INCLUDING TIP. 
How colour only can cost $258 is just beyond me. I was never quoted or consulted on the insane price before I went to pay.  You can easily get the same results for a FRACTION Of the price anywhere else in the city.  Save your money and book at hair fx instead.

"Manager" (nearly bald older guy with glasses) was ignorant towards some younger employees, then ended up being just as ignorant towards [us] at check out. He needs an attitude adjustment and shouldn't be working with public until so. Other than that, store is stocked decent.

A little birdie told me that excellent pho can be had in St. Albert so off I went to answer this question: can there actually be good pho in the vanilla suburb of St. Albert?

Pho Anh Sang is in a strip mall along St. Albert Trail, don't blink as its signage is completely dwarfed by its neighbours: Fatburgers and Subway.  If you blink you would miss it.  Lots of parking so no issue at all.

Once I walked in, the first impression was questionable.  I arrived shortly after the lunch rush, every table was dirty and the somewhat grouchy waitress motioned me towards one of the dirty table, there I sat and waited.  There were a few holes along the wall, the place definitely need a little bit of TLC.  The TV showing the news looked like it has been on continuously since the 80s and the place relied on the two small windows for light, not very bright at all.

It looked like the waitress was doing bookkeeping work at the end table and my arrival had interrupted her.  Eventually she came with tea, menu and a dirty cloth.  She seriously needed to wash that cloth, it reeked of week old food.  After the waitress wiped the table, the entire table smelled sour and unappetizing; I considered walking out after smelling the cloth.  The complimentary tea was really weak and borderline on being classified as warm water.  I quickly ordered the large #36 pho with briskets, tendons and ve don and hoped for the best.

There were the usual assortment of condiments: saracha, hoisin, chili oil, chili sauce, a nice sprig of basil, a small bit of lime and a good amount of sprouts; oh wait, no fresh peppers?  Sadness hit me, they didn't have any of my beloved fresh thai chilis.  

The food service was slower than most pho places, I had enough time to write 3 or 4 emails, which is slow by pho standards.  The bowl arrived steaming hot and smelled fantastic.  I took a spoonful before adding the condiments, it was delicious, a bit lighter than most other restaurants' broth but it was good broth; as good as any other broth I have tasted.  Some may argue that it needed salt but I would say that it was perfect; once the appropriate amount of chili oil has been added, of course.

Toppings wise, there was an adequate amount of meat on top.  The ve don was disappointing, the menu mentioned "crunchy frank" but I was served soft overcooked frank slices.  The portion was quite generous though with a good amount of noodles.  At $9.50 for a large, I really can't complain about the value at all.  

When I was ready to leave, I stood at the cashier counter for a long time, watching commercial after commercial on TV, the waitress never came but eventually the chef himself came out to take my money.  

So, was it worth the drive to St. Albert to experience Pho Anh Sang's bowl of pho, yes it was, the broth was amazing.  Would I stop here again, yes, if I am in the neighbourhood.  Overall, the service was questionable, the staffs can use a little bit of restaurant hygiene training, the place can use some fixing-up but the pho was top notch (skip the ve don though) - take out may be a good alternative here.

Be"careful, the "gel wax" they used during my eyebrow wax caused some kind of reaction, swelling and redness the next day.  I think the wax could have been old, too hot or possible contaminated.  The manager was polite but ambivalent, really had no interest in the reaction and no apology to offer - would have been nice to have an apology or a refund at least offered....... I certainly won't be risking this again at Mimosa.

Wow! This establishment gets 5 stars alone for its excellent customer service! 

Ironically, I have never been to this spa but I was looking to buy a gift certificate for my girlfriend who lives in the St. Albert area. I read the reviews for Mimosa and it seemed that everyone who came here had very good things to say about it. I called the spa to buy the gift certificate and the lady I spoke with was very helpful and very pleasant. Since I don't live in St. Albert, she offered to mail it to my friend for no extra charge.

A week went by and I called Mimosa back since my friend hadn't received the GC yet. She offered to mail it again or hold it there for my friend to use when she came for her service. I went with the mailing option again. I no sooner got off the phone and she called me back to say that she would personally deliver it to my friend's mailbox. Now that is going above and beyond! My friend received the GC that night. A very happy customer here :D

BAD CUSTOMER SERVICE SPOILS SPA DAY

I recently purchased a Mimosa gift certificate for a "Relaxing Day of Beauty" for my wife this past Mother's Day. It was to have included; a Facial, manicure, pedicure, massage and lunch. ( $300.00) Needless to say, my wife was very much looking forward to her special day. When she called the spa to book her "day", she clearly communicated to the receptionist, she had been given a Gift Certificate, for a spa "day" and was wanting to set up her visit. She was offered a choice of 9 AM or 11AM. She choose the 11:00 am time and proceeded to show up on the arranged date and time.  

When she arrived she was informed that the Spa would not be able to accommodate her full day, as that required the earlier 9:00 am start time.  (Would have been nice if they had mentioned that right from the day she booked) As such, they could not provide all  the services I had purchased in the short time frame they had remaining, they would be happy to breakup her package and she would be allowed to return another day for the reminder of the services I'd paid for.  The Manager even went so far as to give her a receipt for services credit. 

Disappointed and having been so looking forward to her day, she agreed to go ahead with the Facial and Massage and lunch. Both services which were rendered  were satisfactory, but certainly nothing special.  She hoped that her lunch would at least be better.  

She was then informed her lunch would not be available as the Spa required advance notice so they could order in the food! Wait a minute, shouldn't that have happened when she called to book the appointment, she had indicated when she booked, the Gift Certificate clearly stated; includes lunch.  Or even the morning of, when the customer arrives, how hard can it be to get food delivered, regardless, it is indicative of the level of poor Quality Customer Service available 

Needless to say, she returned home  very disappointed with the entire experience as a result. After hearing about her experience, I called and attempted to speak to the Manager of the Spa, but she just was full of lame excuses, accepting no responsibility and in fact defending her receptionist as professional when she clearly is unable or unqualified to accurately book appointments in my humble opinion.  I reiterated my concerns at the time offering her a chance to make it right! Ultimately, my frustration level must have overwhelmed her and she Hung-up on me...Nice.

No problem, I placed a call to the Owner of Mimosa, shared my wife's experience, as well as my surprise in a Manager's lack of ability to handle a customer complaint.  (how long do you think she'd last in any kind of real company, i mean who hangs up on a Customer, even /especially an upset one!)  The Owner was neither business savvy enough ( the profit you made from us will not cover your loses from future potential customer's who read this!) or simply unwilling to rectify this situation to my full and complete satisfaction, which was simply to reset the whole thing and give her her full spa day as promised and paid for. Bottom-line, there are far better Spas to which you can send your loved ones, I encourage you to do so!

Going out for heart shaped pizzas on Palentine's Day has been a tradition for me and my friends for many years.  We normally have a longer than usual wait which is understandable as these heart shaped pizzas are only available on February 14. 

However our experience this year was the worst one to date. We waited over 1.5 hours for our pizzas as we watched box after box leave the restaurant for take out orders. 

Our waiter was great at managing the bar area that hadn't seen a pizza come out to our area for over a full hour. However, I believe the management of the online orders and phone orders was handled poorly as they all appeared to be getting their pizzas quicker than those in the restaurant. 

Even after our pizzas came out, one of the four was made incorrectly.  I will definitely have to start looking at other restaurants that offer heart shaped pizzas as 1.5 hours is unreasonable to wait for a meal.

Great coffee, great service!  The food is a bit bland (I had the eggs Benedict) but the coffee refills kept coming so that definitely made up for it. 
Update:  last two visits in 2019 have knocked off one star.  Cold hash browns (and I mean ice cold as if they were taken off someone else's plate) and feeling rushed to finish and pay resulting in a low tip.

Worst experience ever! I had a groupon and was suposed to have choice of 1 of 2 scrubs...no choice...the lady didnt speak much english which isnt the biggest deal but it was hard to express my concerns...She never told me what she was doing...this was my first scrub and facial...I was wrapped in a hot bag and not asked once if I was okay...I was way to hot...she seemed mad when i asked to be taken out....she was very sick and breathing heavy over my face...gross....

I had goop shoved up my nose and I broke out the next day....

Today I went in to register my new vehicle. The registry agent was Kayleen, she was very friendly and made the whole process very easy for me. Overall I was very impressed with Drayden insurance, and highly recommend it.

This location is both hit and miss for service and food.  It can be pretty good or down right disappointing.

The moral of the story is, BP's is good for lunch or watching a game in the bar.

If you're coming for lunch, I recommend the chicken bacon personal pizza and side for $10.  Skip the doughcano, it' s a disappointment.  

If hungrier or coming for dinner, I do enjoy the pizza wrapped bacon burger but they could improve upon it with a dipping sauce or optional ingredients inside like jalapeños. 

I'm much rather drop $70 somewhere in China Town or at the Keg rather than supper for a family of 4 here.

While the waitstaff are always friendly and accommodating, there always seems to be something wrong or missing from our orders and/or bill.

Conveniently located just 5 minutes off the Anthony Henday in St. Albert.   And they opened their doors in 2010 so you know they've stood the test of time with many happy customers.

From the moment I stepped through the doors, I entered an beautiful, relaxing, and inviting space.  

A friend recommended a hot and cold stone massage from Kassie here so I had to give it a try!  Everything was perfect from the super comfy large massage table to the decor and music.  I left refreshed and ready to conquer the world... okay, maybe to steal a few zzz's while my kids were at school ;-)

I wish I had discovered them sooner and will most definitely be back! 

The spa offers a variety of services including pedicures, microdermabrasion, eyelash extensions, massage, body treatments, etc. 

Follow their Facebook page for current promotions and special packages.

I went there a couple of times, and eventhough, the receptionist is friendly, and they offer you tea, coffee, water, etc.  the Master Hairstylist who I went to a couple of times, totally butchered my hair.  and I would never go back to her again, or pay that price that she was charging me for a haircut.   if you do ask for a master hairstylist, be very wary of who is cutting your hair.

I'm really unhappy with the service I received. They forgot my appetizer and my dessert. It took them TWO HOURS to bring it out. It was awful. They brought my entree, then my dessert then my appetizer. In that order. And they made my entree with gluten when I'm gluten intolerant and specifically asked for gluten free. Then they told me that I would also have to pay for my gluten pizza as well as my gluten free pizza. I would rate 0 stars if I could.

I would rate this 100 stars if I could! 

I received a gift from my parents for one of their Full Day packages (mani/pedi, 1 hour massage, body scrub, facial and lunch) before I graduated high school. The total price came to about $330 which I thought was amazing considering all the different services I received! Every staff member was super friendly and made me feel comfortable and welcome and they all did a fantastic job. 

The decor inside is very modern and it's always spotless around the building. 

My graduation gift there was my first visit to the spa and ever since then, I've always gone here to get my mani/pedis and everything else done.

We first met Jordy from Prestige Electric 3 years ago when getting a new AC install.  

We also had him do an additional outlet panel on the outside of our house as our current line had accidentally been cut by neighbours during a fence install.   

We are currently in the midst of doing a kitchen renovation and just had Jordy come out again for new estimates on moving our fridge/freezer wall and fixing a couple other outlets in our Aluminum wired nightmare older home.  As always, he was prompt, professional, informative, and easy to talk to. 

Highly recommend Jordy and Prestige Electric.

Hmm... Hard to say.

I had a not so good experience here where they gave completely inaccurate information and refused to phone whoever is in charge of registries for clarification.  I had to take mother, a recent immigrant to Canada, to a different registries office to sort out the issue.  If we had listened to this location, my mother would have had to surrender her still valid driver's license from the United States and that would have been a horrible mistake!

On the other hand, when I have come in to do simple things like renew my own license and registration they have been easy peasy.  

Hopefully our unfortunate experience was an isolated experience but it certainly made for a stressful day for my elderly mother.

This place is certainly not the most high end..but what their great at is cheep and cheerful! And they do it well..the pedicures are 30 bucks and they do a pretty good job. I especially love getting the little designs they do..I got a butterfly on one toe, and three flowers on the other. Its a great way to get into the mood for spring..even if my feet will be stuck in UGGs for another month!

A good place to spend a Friday afternoon if I do say so myself :)
Excellent service! We were treated like princesses! The pedicure massage chair was phenomenal!! Will definitely come again!

My gripe is that I was quoted a certain amount for hair colour; but was additionally charged a $15 "finishing fee", that was neither quoted nor discussed.  I also did not appreciate my 'intermediate'-level stylist I paid for rushing off to serve another customer, having another one finish off.  Wreaks of unethical business practice and disrespect.

This spa is located in Campbell Business Park across from the casino in St. Albert. Locally owned and operated this spa is geared toward relaxation and rejuvenation in a calming setting. I have been going to Mimosa since they opened in March 2010 and have experienced several exceptional services - pedicure, facial, manicure, and waxing to name a few. 

All of the staff are professionally trained and extremely knowledgeable of all the services offered. I had returned from a 4 month trip to a more humid climate (let's be honest, it is hard to go somewhere that isn't more humid then Edmonton) and was having trouble with breakouts on my face - I didn't know which facial would be best. But I didn't need to worry as the owner was able to tailor a facial specifically to my needs. I was very impressed with the results and feel that helped my skin adjust overall to being back in Edmonton. 

My favorite service is the pedicure. You can select between several options - I generally go with the Express Pedicure and then every once in a while spoil myself and splurge on the Signature Pedicure. They have the big relaxing massage chairs so the whole time your feet and lower legs are being pampered you can also be enjoying a back and neck massage.

Mimosa also offer a membership for regular visitors - the membership has several benefits including discounts on all services so I think it is worth it even if you only go a couple times in a year.

I love Mimosa and will continue to return regularly. I have also referred family and friends and they have all had the same wonderful experience as I do.

I was seriously disappointed with this restaurant. Apparently they are known for their awesome breakfasts, but ours was terrible. 

The hash browns were barely cooked and unseasoned. And my eggs Benedict was awful. The hollandaise sauce tasted like margarine. 

Awful. We won't be going back.

I went through the A&W drive thru and was disappointed with my experience and the quality of the food. 

First of all, the wait was longer than normal and the staff at the window were less than thrilled to be there. Due to the long wait, I figured we would get fresh food but i was wrong. The egg on the bacon & egger was not completely cooked and it was dripping everywhere. This ruined our appetite.

People don't mind waiting and paying a bit more for quality food, however, I can confidently say I am not in any rush to go back to this location.

The manager, her name is Joyce according to the girl thats giving me a pedicure right now, is very rude. I feel bad for these two girls who have to deal with her everyday. My appointment was at 11, the manager called me at 10.35am, gave me shit saying 'you know you have an appointment at 10.30', i said no my appointment's at 11, she argued with me and told me how im not supposed to be late and stuff, i was driving so i just told her im on my way. I came from the southside of edmonton all the way to st albert and so yea i came 15mins later, when i came in one of the staffs opened the locked door for me, i talked to her and told her i have an appointment, and suddenly the manager was in a hidden desk behind me and butted in our conversation saying your half an hour late and gave me shit again, its not like theyre busy and have to keep up on their schedule, cos i am the only customer here! So instead of coming here for relaxation, all i got was a stressful 2hrs! They started talking between them in chinese with the manager pointing at the clock, so i assumed theyre talking about me being late i did apologize and even explained myself cos i was guilty of being late but she was just giving me attitude! I think she is in the wrong side of business, she has to deal with a lot of women and women are most of the time, always late anyways. I was planning to get some other things done like gettin a haircut and stuff but her attitude turned me off. And she told me too that she will shorten my body wrap time, i told her i paid for the whole 50 minutes and im gonna get less? That doesn't make sense, and she said ok but you have to wait for 2 hours before you can have your body wrap. So to make this long story short, if you want togo for a relaxed day at a spa, please stay away from this salon. The dealfind price is not even worth it!

Appointment for a set of gel nails was at 3:00pm and they finally finished at 6:00pm.  Three hours for gel nails was ridiculous!!

The girl I had used the drill so much she removed all the sparkles from the tip of the nail and most of them from two others, so I asked for them to replace them.  They tried to convince me that when they put the clear gel on the sparkles would come back.  Eventually they replaced the worst of the nails.

My friend who was also getting hers done at the same time had to wait 30 minutes to start since they double booked a waxing at the same time but only had two staff members.  Once it go started they applied too much gel so it melted a burned her several times.  They told her she had her fingers at the wrong angle so she had to hold them at an incredibly awkward angle.

Two previous clients had to wait to have their parafin removed for 45 minutes as their appointment overlapped ours.

After we left my gel nails started to seperate from my nail and hers were raised at the tip because of the angle she had had to hold her fingers at.

Terrible experience! Never go here!!
I have been going to this spa since it opened 6 years ago, amazing service, wonderful down to earth staff, I wouldn't go anywhere else now! Highly recommended

I went to the Rock for a hair cut and my eyebrows done.  I like that they use Aveda products. The girl did a nice cut and style but it was crazy expensive. And it was not with a master stylist.Eyebrow fee was about the same as anyplace else and the girl was really good, and bubbly which I like. Stylist was low key. 
I wish though that they did my eyebrows in a private service room like other Aveda salons I have been to.The pedicures are done in the open next to the eyebrow bed. I felt awkward. But great experience otherwise. I will go back for Spa services but I can't imagine spending $135 on a medium layered cut again.

Chantelle has been my stylist for the past 30 years.   I have chosen to change salons as she, as the owner, is not vaccinated.   I was told that my colour formula would be given to the new salon that I choose.   The salon I chose called The Rock and was told my file had been deleted.    The time frame of me being told by Shea, her daughter, that the formula would only be given to another salon was a matter of a few days.    Nice........if you're a business that deals with people daily, you should be responsible and be vaccinated.   All you have to do is look at the health care system and see what's happening.   In the end, it is just hair and I will be fine with a new stylist.   Please get vaccinated.

First impression was that it was a bit run down at this spa, that being said I do Love my eyelash extensions I got done here for a trip. $60 for first time with the groupon. Application went well and price was great on the groupon though it is a bit high for me with $120 regular and $100 for two week fills... ladies were professional and the spa was very clean.

A & W has always had my favourite onion rings since my teen years, no matter where I've lived or visited, and they are just as good here.

They also have frequent "specials" like the current Teen Burger at only $3, but you need to know about them or ask what is current, because most often there is no signage outside.  If you're doing the drive-in window, you have no way of knowing unless you inquire at the speaker box, which is a bit annoying.  

I have a soft spot in my heart for this location, though, because of an incident a few years ago.  My granddaughter was totally humiliated when she knocked over a full ice cream float that managed to cover several meters in every directions and soak both of us.   Staff quickly and quietly mopped it up, smiling at her and easing her discomfort, and even replaced the drink.

Absolutely wonderful massage... She worked out all of my stress and tension and I came in like a knot and walked out so relaxed.!! Super friendly very clean. Wonderful! 

The only negative, it wasn't quiet. There was a person there doing a skin lesson and I heard the majority of her presentation through the peaceful sounds being played in the room.

As a  loyal customer to the Rock, this frustrates me to write. Normally, when I go there, I get a trim and foils. April 2014, the stylist did not COMPLETE the job and it was $250. Parts of my hair were noticeably different with in a WEEK. 
May 2014, I went to rectify this and was hoping to receive 10% or or SOMETHING. Not only did the stylist charge me MORE, but there was also a "finishing fee" as I did not get a hair cut for $25 which was NOT discussed BEFOREHAND. Now in June, I am noticing chunks of my hair that are different from the TOP and BOTTOM of my hair, along with the same INCOMPLETE service.
I DO NOT RECOMMEND the Rock.
I've been coming here for years, the new location is great. Parking lots huge and the wait times are always short. Lady's here are very helpful.

Terrible job, some nails had nail polish not only on the nail but also on the finger and other nails had no polish on the sides.  The color was uneven did not go down to the cuticle and when I pointed this out she just applied more coats.  Nail poslish was so thick that it scraped off the minute I touched something, just peeling off the following day!  Absolute worst experience in a nail salon.  My daughter also had her nails done and had grown her nails and the first thing the girl did is cut them short!  Another girl took over when she saw what the first girl had done!

I went in to this location today to grab some lunch for me and my bf. I had a coupon they sent out in the junk mail, it was a 2 Mottza burger, 2 drinks, and 2 fries kinda deal.

So I had asked her if I could change one of the burgers to a chubby chicken burger..thinking it would be no big deal....Apparently, its a huge deal for them, and there was a big spiel as to why they couldn't allow that. OK; so fine 2 mottza burgers it is. 

Except for that when we got home and opened them it was 2 teen burgers..in double teen burger wrapping. Well done, well done.

We ended up at this Ricky's in the middle of a weekday with a party of about 20 people without a reservation.  I imagine they were not prepared for such a thing but you'd never know it.  Our party was welcomely accommodated and seated quickly. The servers were jovial and nice.  My part of the table shared some appetizers and they were delicious! I looked enviously at the fish and chips others were having as well.  Everyone enjoyed the food.  Beverage refills occurred quickly.  There is lots of parking.  A pleasant lunch experience.

Canadian Tire is hit and miss for me.  Some things are great for value others are WAY overpriced.

Recently, I found a great fondue set here for a special night at home.  I read all kinds of reviews online and checked 5 stores, and the best price and quality for your $ was to be found here!

We've always received great customer service at this location as well.

We've utilized the automotive store twice now for a $25-$30 walk-in chip repair on our car window.  The quality and price were great for the service but both times the estimated completion time was a half hour to hour longer than quoted.  The waiting room is spacious with couches, a television, and a vending machine but then again you can buy snacks in the store, too.

Overall, I'm glad to have Canadian Tire but you really have to know your prices to be sure you aren't paying double the Walmart or Superstore equivalent.

And don't forget you can collect Canadian Tire Cash for your next purchase or donate in the puppy statue on your way out!

Encountered a very bad experience with a gel nail fill (first time in this salon).  Appeared that the young technician had come to this country recently and was in training.  She did not know how to properly prepare the nails for a gel application and destroyed my nail beds.  I had to return within 3 days as the application had failed.  The worst job I ever experienced in 25 years.  I felt it necessary to share.

Just realized my previous review should actually have been posted for the other St Albert site, this was my first time at this location, but they are pretty interchangeable.

Wanted to try the much -advertised Cactus Nachos and it turned into a comedy of errors.  At the recommendation of our waitress, we chose the Perogy version (there's also a steak one) and when it arrived, noticed that the chips (potato slices) were not warm and the cheese wasn't gooey, but instead had solidified.  We asked for a replacement, which was cheerfully provided and dug in.  The amount of toppings is magnificent - this is LOADED with cheese and bacon and jalapeño goodness.  I was remarking how unusual and appreciated it was that the toppings were not just on the top, but actually interspersed through the next layer, when the second issue arose... none of the cheese under the first layer had melted at all.   We pointed this out to the manager and asked could it be nuked a bit, and he was quite surprised by the cheese, saying they had a special oven just for this dish and it shouldn't have happened.  He returned it quickly, all melty and gooey, except by now the potatoes were a bit over-done and not so tasty anymore.  In spite of all this, I have high hopes they'll iron out the details of how to get this fixed and to the table correctly, and would try the other version on my next visit.  It's an impressive plate that was too much food for just two people and a nice variation on nachos.

Special kudos to our server, Ali, who actually checked with the Momma figure before telling the little one what her drink choices were, in case sodas weren't approved - a very thoughtful gesture that I wish more places would incorporate.  If a parent only wants their child to choose milk or juice, offering them soda is only going to start the whole meal with an argument and some pouting.

Worst Pho ever.
Ordered by Skip the Dishes and we got garbage. The Pho order was 2 large Steak, and requested to have veggies added. What we got was 2 child sizes orders because the kids were marked as "Less meat, add veg". And guess what? No veggies.
I'm sticking to my normal restaurant- Pho Han Pastuer

My friend treated me to a day at Heavenly Essence as my bridal gift. I had the pedicure, the blueberry soy body wrap, and the signature facial...all 3 were amazing! I had the same person doing all of my treatments which was really nice because I got to know her and develop a sense of comfort with her. She was really friendly and talented. She was also very knowledgeable about the natural products they use at the spa and there was zero pressure to buy the products which I really appreciated. The salon itself is located in a brand new development so it was really clean with brand new furnishings...the massage chair in the pedicure area as especially lovely. I walked out of there on cloud 9 feeling super relaxed.

We had some intermittent power issues in our house and Prestige was highly recommended to us through a few trades people that we knew. The gentleman that came was courteous, respectful of our space and diagnosed the problem and was able to resolve it quickly. He also did a full check up of our house for anything electrical related as part of their routine calls for any matter they're brought in for. Very pleased with the service and price, give Prestige a call for anything electrical!
Great selection of Spring items for your backyard and front yard. Tools as well to help with new lawn seeding or existing lawns to repair.

their soup tastes great, it doesnt have loads of meat but i dont mind hte broth its nice, i love their green onion cakes, and the garlicky chili sauce they have i asked n its home made it tastes amazing!! also its very cheap and filling, a great option on a cold day

Great service tonight at this BP's location considering how busy it was, birthday party and couple large groups. Refills were done before we asked and food came out quick mind you salad bowls with grilled chicken do not have to be hot served . Very attentive staff at this Boston Pizza, I have not being here in years.

I like this store because it's always well maintained and I've always had good service. The shelves are always stocked, the store is clean, well organized as well as their toilets. Their online site is great to. You can check the product you want, what aisle it's in and how many they have. Their staff are always friendly and helpful and returns are never a problem. I really like this store and recommend it.

My favourite restaurant in st albert! Super friendly staff. Their breakfast is just amazing, I've tried nearly all of their items by now. The bennies or waffles are probably my favorites if i had to choose. I love their burgers and pastas from their dinner menu, especially the Pesto Fettuccine.
I also tried the new gelato and it's the best I've ever had.

Unfortunately I did not go to my usual stylist, Tara, who is fantastic at colouring.  I had a new person who had not been there that long. The attitude of this stylist was terrible. Dismissive, bordering on rude. And my roots were not covered - within 2 days I had 2 cm of grey. I called the salon back and was treated as if I was at fault!  I went to another salon a few days later and had to pay another $120 to get my hair recoloured. That Salon was appalled by the poor job done at the Rock, and first suggested I go back there for a redo. However, I indicated that I was not prepared to go back due to the poor attitude all around. As an aside, I also had a Brazilian wax at the same time at the Rock, and I saw later that this was also not done correctly. All in all, a waste of over $200.

Have had breakfast here a couple of times now, and lunch once. Service is good, friendly, fast and efficient. Food is typical for this type of restaurant but done perfectly and it is tasty. I ordered eggs poached soft, crispy bacon and rye toast with well browned shredded hash browns. Came out perfect, which it rarely does in most places.

Have only been there on weekdays. Breakfast the place is VERY quiet, lunch was about half full, so no waits to get in. Only draw back is I find their prices pretty high for a chain of this type. Breakfast for two, with a tip, is pretty close to $30, and we weren't ordering anything real fancy. 

Despite the good food and service I would normally have rated it a three because the prices are so high. However, this is St Albert, and restaurant prices are on average higher than Edm, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove etc, I guess they aren't too far out of line for where they are. The taxes in St Albert are atrocious so the businesses need to make it back somehow. Food and service are a four, if you want cheaper eats you need to head to Edmonton.
