Went for a facial at this spa and it was wonderful. Nicole did such a great job. I will go back again. The products used are all natural and smell/feel amazing. You can tell they are high quality. Nicole explained everything she was doing and gave the best facial massage ever! It was relaxing and helpful. She did extractions to help my pores and I can't wait till I can go back for my next facial. Highly recommend. Also, the decor and spa is beautiful. It's modern and clean, but still homey.

The people at registrations are nice, but this review is more about the insurance aspect of this business. I don't know if the brokers only work for Intact Insurance or if they are not willing to assess other insurance companies for their clients, but the insurance offered at Drayden is awful. I was quoted $360 a month when I bought my new vehicle, then i was charged $390 for the following two months. I didn't even feel like asking why i was charged extra, I just started calling around to different insurance companies to get quotes. I called EIGHT different insurance companies and brokerages, and not one of them quoted me anything higher than $300. I have no hecking idea why I was being charged close to $400 with Intact as a driver with no tickets or accidents (and as a female.) Switching to TD saved me $150 a month (TD is only charging me $240 a month for my insurance.) Intact is absolute crap and Drayden as an insurance brokerage is garbage for trying to sell their clients dramatically overpriced insurance. If i knew i would have been getting overcharged for my insurance for YEARS i never would have gone to Drayden for my insurance, and i definitely wouldn't have signed up with Intact.

Registry side of things is awful. Racism is clear and apparent there. My wife and I went in to transfer her license over from Mexico ( permanent Residence) we brought all the paperwork required.  Drivers abstract,  Mexican license, translation,  a peice of mail, marriage certificate, permanent Residence paperwork,  rental agreements etc. English is a second language for and we asked for her exam to be done in Spanish. Half the test was in English half in Spanish. She obviously failed. They would not let her redo the exam. We drove over and hour to get there and with a 5 month old. Like many albertans I work out of town and didn't want to leave my wife and 5 month old alone without a vehical in rural Alberta.
The younge woman we delt with was extremely rude and impatient as I tried to explain the situation. Too many eye rolls. Smacking her gums.
It was clear she had no intent on providing us services that day.
She would also not allow me to register my new vehicle. I had provided a bill of sale, mechanical inspection, drivers license and proof of insurance.
She would not accept my bill of sale. Good enough for insurance purposes but not for her.
I didn't get her name but had eye lash extensions and make up that looked like Me me from the drew Carey show....what a gem she was.

Ordered this place Skip the Dishes. I actually couldn't eat my beef sate as it smelt absolutely wretched. There were no veggies in it and the basil that came with it was rotten. Sons regular pho looks like water for broth- flavorless and just off looking.

My wife has visited the Rock Salon for massages and to purchase all her hair products.  Last week I stopped in at the x-ray clinic next door but could find no parking in the area.  As we were customers of the Rock, I parked in one of their spots for 5 minutes maximum while I ran in.  Today I received a $40.00 parking ticket in the mail that they had reported I parked in one of their 5 empty spots for 5 minutes.  I hope they feel this 40 dollar fine to me is worth the loss of our business and all of our friends and anyone else we can pass this message on to.

I came back to this spa after another local spot changed ownership and lost a bit of it's skill set in the change (just my opinion). While I never had issues with their services before I changed providers I just had scheduling issues and the other spot was closer to my job. Having returned to use their waxing services a number of times since leaving the other business I have yet to be disappointed. Each appointment is better than the next. I've had a number of different techs but each one has been pleasant, knowledgeable and efficient. I'll definitely keep coming back.

We have used Prestige many times for personal and commercial jobs. My wife and I had Prestige install an outlet and run cables for us to mount a TV on a ledge. The process was quick and easy. Billing was exactly as quoted and they cleaned up after their mess! 

My mom lives alone and also used Prestige to install new outlets and help install a treadmill in her home. She lives in an older house and was really thankful for the time and care that Prestige put into the job. 

Lastly, my wife is on the board for our condo complex and had Jordy and his team do an electrical audit for more than 100 units. He went above and beyond working with the board and showing up to meetings to explain his findings. He went above and beyond. 

We are thankful to have Jordy and his team of electricians when we need help. It is great to find a company that you can trust and know that they will take care of your family as well! 

Would highly recommend!

Go to JD Nails if you like to pay High Prices for low quality service.
The cleanliness of the place I would say is below average, dead skin everywhere.
I had a pedi and mani booked.  I like to go for a relaxing time, but it was far from that.  They did my mani while I was getting my pedi done.  I had to balance the UV heater on my lap which was plugged in and my heat are in water...does that sound safe to you?
They asked me if I would like to get my nailes Shellaced instead of polished and at the end was an EXTRA $30 and there was no mention of the extra cost.
Dead Skin+Unrelaxing+Unsafe situation+Unmentioned Extra Costs = never going there again.

I dropped in last hour (4PM) last friday May 29, 2020 to get insurance and registration for a car I brought. Both the insurance and registration side were effective and efficient in their tasks. I am especially pleased with Monica in the insurance side who never wasted time and got working into my insurance as soon as I dropped in. While working on the paperworks she took advantage of email and phone calls to get things going. I am a very satisfied cutomer. Thank you.

Hubby and I are working from home on our second floor and needed to hardwire the internet for faster connection. Prestige Electric quickly solved not only this, but also all of our electrical problems in the house for very reasonable price. They did a thorough electrical inspection, gave us valuable safety tips and answered our many questions. Jordy and his team are very organized, helpful, modern and professional! We highly recommend Prestige Electric!

Jordy and his team at Prestige Electric are amazing! 

It all started with Jordy coming into our private gym, took his time to understand my vision and my business. He then gave me his professional opinion to what would look the best and what would be most efficient and cost effective. 

When installing, they were very accommodating by coming in to install during low traffic and closed business hours to not affect our gym operations. The team had great communication with myself throughout the whole process and Jordy even made sure everything was on track with check in calls even though the install only took a few days. 

The install was swift, tidy and painless. The end result,  brilliant, and bright LED lighting that will last for ages! No more waiting for old lighting lamps to warm up with continuing buzzing. 

I could not be happier with the results. Look for yourself! The pictures attached show you the quality of the end results and how bright and professional it looks. 

I would highly recommend Jordy and his team to install any electrical service(s) you need. I know who to call for all my needs in the future! 

Thank you again Jordy!

Sounds like many of us have nothing good to say about this place.  It's a very unprofessional and cold environment.  The staff are rude.  They speak to each other in Chinese but make no conversation or eye contact with patrons.  When they did speak, it was short and abrupt.  I went 2x only because I bought vouchers.  The 1st time, I was supposed to have a 50min massage.  I was only given a 25 minute massage!  My friend & I went the 2nd time and were there first thing in the morning.  Because I had to leave early, I had all my services done first.  When I left, all my friend needed was her manicure.  They totally ignored her, served several other customers coming in.  We got there at 10am but my friend didn't leave until almost 3 o'clock!!!   It's beyond me that this place is still in business.  I would never, EVER recommend this place.  I only gave it a single star rating because I have to give one to post.

Super convenient location right next to Servus Place. 

This is our go to on our way to hockey.

The downside about this location is its inside a gas station so they have a smaller menu.  Frequently they don't have vanilla dips which is the only donut my kiddo wants, lol. 

But this location is perfect for me to grab a quick cup of joe or tea to stay warm at the rink.

Ive never been more disappointed. Your staff talks more to eachother then the customers (screwing up orders, giving the wrong orders to wrong people) also not to mention maybe lucky to actually have my coffee made right and maybe even my food correctly. Unbelievable. You all need to pay more attention to orders, i came close to loosing my life because of mayonnaise on a wrap. Get your shit together. Also get a garbage can outside of your damn store.

In looking for a hair salon in St. Albert, I came upon The Rock's name and starting reading their poor reviews and simply had to share my story.  Years ago, my entire family went faithfully to the Rock.  We bought all of our hair product there and never went anywhere else.  We spent hundreds of dollars a year.  As a birthday present, my husband bought a sizeable gift certificate for me.  It only had a couple month expiration period and he specifically asked about it.  They said "no worries...we will honour it past due date...just to encourage people to use it"  I was thrilled with my gift but noticed it was going to expire so called and the receptionist told me same spiel as they told my husband.  I booked a hair appointment, cut and color as well as a spa treatment.  When I went to use my certificate, they would not honour it.  I was mortified.  Legally, I know that they have to stand behind the representations their employees make and they would have had to honour it if I chose to go to small claims but I would have spent far more than the $300 fighting it.  I wrote the manager and the owner and did not even get the courtesy of a reply.  St. Albert is a small community.  I have shared my story many times.  They are crooks.

The girl who did my hair was great, even going so far as to offer me a quote on what we were doing. She was friendly and did exactly what I wanted with my colour. I wasn't impressed with her straightening job but was in a hurry so I figured I'd fix it at home. At the end, the quote for foils was $179 but somehow I was still charged $225. They claimed the rest was for blow drying and finishing but that should have been included. When I said I wasn't happy with that part, my bill went down to $203 but I still have no idea how they got that number when all they did was color my hair. My sister in law had the same problem. She was charged even more for a full color!

We both left there feeling sick about the experience. It feels like they're just trying to squeeze money out of people. If the prices were up front, people wouldn't leave feeling so ripped off. The girl who did my hair was awesome but the experience left me feeling sick, even the next day.

Only rating this based on the store and not the service department (though I've heard more horror stories about that part from many people).
Out of all 4 Canadian Tires stores I've gone to (northeast, northwest and downtown), this is the only one I have found to always have items I'm looking for in stock.  As well, it seems to be more cleaner and cluttered than the other ones.
I find for home improvement things they sometimes have better prices than Home Depot or Lowe's, just have to shop around.
Great service, good stock, amazing sales, and it's Canadian.

Why oh why did I not read the reviews before walking in to this location.  What a mistake!  As soon as I had seen everybody talking about how they use the dremmel (I think that's what it's called?  the drill thing?) to remove shellac/gel polish, I would have ran the other way.  But for whatever reason, when she pulled out the drill, I stayed silent.  I know that's my own fault.  But I feel a little intimidated in nail salons.  I don't understand how everything (anything) works, so I usually don't question things.

I have fairly brittle nails.  Gel polish helps to keep them stronger so they can actually grow a little and not break off.  But when you use the drill to remove the polish, you take a sizeable amount of nail with it.  I understand that it is quicker for the tech to do it this way, but it is also very damaging.  

The gel polish selection was vast... that was nice.  But the very next day, a finger nail has broken.  

I also felt that $36 was pretty steep just to change the polish, when a shellac manicure would have only cost $5 more.

The service was fine, some of the ladies were great, others not so much. 
I was with a couple girl friends and their nails turned out very nice. On the other hand and by luck of pulling the short straw the lady who ended up doing my nails butchered the skin around and didn't even get all of the nail painted. I left with paint on my skin and will have to do my own touch up at home, even though they noticed me picking at the paint and not looking too impressed!

I've eaten here several times in the last couple of months, experiencing both good and not-so-good food.  There's a special each day, and I recommend the half-price chicken wings on Wednesday, available with a large variety in choice of saucing ( I liked the Thai chili).   Friday is a discount on their rack of pork ribs, which should have been a real treat, but instead were so dry and tough that it was a challenge to cut them apart, and an even bigger challenge to chew them.  I don't think I'd take a chance on ordering them again.   My favourite so far has been the Southwestern Flat bread, with adequate toppings and a nice thin flavourful crust.

Kids meals have improved since the last reviews I read, with more choices than I expected, and fresh veggies as one of the sides - yay for a bit of health thrown in with all the carbs!  It also included ice cream with candy toppings, which were a hit with my wee companions.

The parking lot has been full each time we've gone, although the restaurant itself wasn't overly crowded, so I assume the bar does a good business.

One weird note - I thought we were at a swimming pool when I visited the washroom - the odour of choline (bleach?) was so strong.  I guess that's better than what it might have smelled like, but it didn't enhance the dining experience.

Had attentive service each visit.  I foresee future visits mostly because the kiddos like it their meals and being surrounded by so many giant TV screens  :-)

======

Added note:  Seriously, skip the ribs - I've had a stomach ache for the last 6 hours.

Walked in, sat down, waited. Waited and waited and waited. For 15 minutes we sat waiting for menus and to place a drink order. It wasn't like they were too busy, lots of empty seats and lots of people eating and drink. Just not us. Got up and left eventually.

Visited Joe's Famous Donair 2 times this past weekend because it was just that good!

Had a coupon for B1G1 free... Figured, no better time than the present to try my first donair!  Yep, that's right... I was a donair virgin.  Everyone I tell this to thinks I must be some kind of weirdo.  But the truth is, growing up in Seattle, we didn't have Donair stands on every corner or hardly anywhere come to think of it.  Secondly, when I moved to Canada (Edmonton) 8 years ago, I was a vegetarian at the time - not really making me a fan as I would walk by and see giant hunks of animal flesh turning on a spit.

However... 8 years later, hubby still nagging that he misses Donairs, I figured what the hell... let's go grab one RIGHT NOW!

So we hopped in the car and drove on down to Joe's Famous Donairs and Burgers since I had a coupon.  I had already decided that it wasn't going to be a very exciting meal so I might as well be cheap about it!

Hubby and baby stayed in the car while I went inside to order two items to go... after all, toddler and Gramma were at home and it was getting close to nigh night time.

The owner, who turned out to be Bill & not Joe, advised that he had just purchased Joe's Famous Donair & Burgers on December 1, 2011 and that he used to be a chef at a diner in Edmonton.  He was SUPER friendly and in a welcoming and charming kind of way - not in your bubble kind of way. 

It must have been evident I was a Donair virgin from the kinds of questions I was asking.  I wanted to know what was in the infamous "white sauce" because I'm kinda picky and don't like mayo and figured it must be mayo.  Nope - I was wrong!  It was sweet and heavenly - nothing like mayo.  I immediately had to WIKI it and read that it was most likely evaporated milk, sugar, garlic powder, and vinegar and boy oh boy was it ever delis!  And not at all heavy feeling like I had imagined it so many times.  

But anyway... I'm getting ahead of myself...

I asked for his advice on what to order and ended up ordering a Cheese Donair (minus onions) and a Donair Poutine - Yep, that's right, Donair Poutine!  He also told me that I HAD to eat inside the restaurant as it wasn't right to experience my first Donair cold at home.  I told him that I had a hubby and baby in the car, he still insisted I eat inside.  So out I go, into the cold to tell my husband that "Bill" - not "Joe" - insists we eat inside.

We returned inside and the food came promptly and boy oh boy was it ever AMAZING!  Sweet and savoury Donair, where have you been all my life?  The poutine was PHENOMENAL - and this coming from a girl who usually passes up on poutine.  The meat was delicious and not greasy at all (all beef by the way - no lamb served up at this joint) and everything was cooked fresh to order right in front of our eyes.  And the pitas were so fluffy and light - truly like little bites of heaven.  Even my husband, who had said for years and years that Queen Donair in Clareview had the best Donairs, said this place is now at the top of his list!

The value was great even without a coupon - and he has revolving specials running as well.  Currently you can get 2 cheese donairs and a pop for $12 or a free pop with any $12 purchase.  Even though I had used a coupon, he insisted my husband have a free beverage.

My husband and I could not finish the meal - super rich and filling - yet not greasy!  

I awoke the next morning still thinking about how delicious that place was and I can't remember the last time I wanted to eat the same food less than 12 hours later!  So after swim lessons, we took the baby and toddler back to Joe's and tried the Donair burger - Yumm-O!  I had wanted to try his "specialty donair chicken" but he said he doesn't make it on Sundays because that's his slowest day.  Oh darn... we'll just have to go back again!  So we had another cheese donair and onion rings (our toddler's favourite). 

While we were eating, again stuffed to the brim with only 2 items between the 3 of us, he surprised my toddler with a few chicken nuggets and a juice box served on a spongebob plate!  He also changed his television to a cartoon while we were there with our munchkin.  Talk about hospitality!  And I had used a coupon again!  (I have 4 of them that expire in March and you can be sure they aren't going to waste in the next 30 days).  

My recommendation is go eat at Joe's Famous Donair and Burgers NOW! Not tomorrow, not next week... Now!  And be sure to say hello and chat a bit, he's a super nice guy!  

I also uploaded pics of the entrees we had to give you an idea of size!  If I remember correctly the cheese donair combo with fries/onion rings & pop was just under $10 and the donair poutine was $8.75 and the Donair burger was $5.95.  The prices are right, the portions are huge, the food is excellent!  2 Thumbs WAY up!
Horrible service ran out of water and never did get a refill, the food was not good at all it was very awkward the owner called me and my boyfriend "ladies".. on our way out..

Oh Omailles. Why oh why do you fail everytime. My boyfriend and I love the wings here but the service. My gosh the service. it's so horrible. I just don't understand it. 

We went for wings last night which is a ritual for us on Wednesday's. We walked in at 6:48pm (had to change the time on my car so I knew the exact time we we walked in at). We sat at a high top for about 2 minutes and decided it was too cold so moved down to a lower table. Still hadn't been greeted. We sat there until 6:58 without even a hello. I was Turned around in my seat to look for someone to help us out and 3 servers walked by us and didn't say or do anything. I made eye contact with the bartender numerous times as it was obvious I was turned around in my seat. So at 6:59 my boyfriend went up to the bar at which time the bartender turned around and walked away. My boyfriend then walked up to 2 servers standing at the servers station area and asked for some menus. They commented "No one saw you???" Finally a server came over to us. We ordered a couple beers and she returned with them in a reasonable time and at that point we ordered our wings. 

My boyfriend ordered 2lbs (honey hot/s&p) and I ordered 2 as well ( honey hot/lemon pepper) I like mine really crispy and I explained that to her. The wings came out perfect. Mine were super crispy and delicious. And my boyfriends were done normal and super yummy. Their wings are breaded, but not too much. They are our favorite wings in St. Albert so far. I sat with an empty beer for about 4 minutes before she came over and asked if I would like another. We ordered another beer and I went to the washroom at which point I read a sign that Kieth's pints were on special. (would of been nice to know the specials at the beginning before we ordered different pints all night) 

I then ordered a vanilla crunch cake which was okay. Probably came from the fridge because it tasted kind of stale but still ate it all so it couldn't of been that bad! Lol! 

We then got our bills and she was prompt with payments. 

If the wings weren't so delicious we would NEVER go to Omailles. Everytime we go it's the same crap service. One time I actually tipped the food runner instead of our server as he corrected her mistakes and made sure everything was okay once he fixed it. We keep hoping they can get their sh*t together because of the wing night but it seems as if they can't.

Service - the worst 
Food - wings are the best in St. Albert haven't tried much else. 
Washrooms - typical pub washroom. Nothing fancy. Not very nice. 
Ambiance- Irish Pub feel. Rather cold in the restaurant though.  

Please get it together!!

As far as Fast Food goes this place is great. The food tastes healthy, fresh and full of flavour. I like the beef and broccoli, my husband like the pad thai. I really like the iced coffee as well. I also really liked the people who were working there when I went in. They were very nice and polite. The older man had a very nice smile. If you're looking for something quick and easy, I recommend this place.

Neat little Irish themed pub with decent food. Overall the crowd was older and seemed blue coller. The music was classic rock but the decor was definitely Irish. The beer selection was great as well. The burger I ordered was decent and fairly prices. My brother and I had a great time and we will probably return if we are in the neighborhood.

First impressions matter. It's Saturday. It's 9:30 pm. I've been here since 8:00 and this place is almost empty--less than a dozen people. Now this is my first visit, so I don't want to be harsh, but nothing that is going on here is inviting me back. I hope this is not usual. I see on their website they sometimes have live music on the weekend so that may attract more people. Perhaps I'll try again.
I didn't try the food since there are no vegan options. The menu is the standard pub fare and looks inviting if you're looking for that kind of meal.

I was going here 10years ago when it was Franco's. A lot has changed over the years, but this has remained the best Donair shop in St.Albert. I order a #3 w/Cheese everytime (Super Donair w/cheese + Fries + Drink) $15 and that's with a tip
great breakfast menu. portions were plentiful, food was well cooked. There was a line up at 10am, a good sign of a good breakfast place. Staff was friendly, coffee refills plentiful

Tonight my brother and I tried to eat here. We arrived around 650 and we were seated immediately. A waitress placed some water on the table (we were right next to the server's booth). After that not a single employee spoke to us. We waited about 15 mins and then left. I understand when restaurants are busy.....and we probably would have waited longer than 15 mins but we didn't even meet our server. A simple "sorry for the wait" or " I'll be right with you" would have gone a long way. We were only acknowledged when we left with a "Ok, have a nice night."

This has become my go to location!! It has such easy access in and out of Hebert Road that I spin thru the drivethru with super ease the majority of the time. 

Unlike many locations I find the drive thru speaker easy to hear and easy to speak into. This aspect would have to do with the set up of the buildings and the major roads but the flip side is the parking isn't the easiest on the window/ road access side. I recommend parking in the strip mall area and walking the few extra feet or right up at the roadside parking in the middle to avoid difficulty backing up.

Overall my orders are accurate, my food tasty and my coffee delicious. I don't often get much more than coffee and Tim Bits for the kid lets but the odd time when I have been in and ordered I wish I would have at he drive thru as the counter service is fairly sparse compared to the attention the drive thru receives.

Sorry to say I won't go back again. I went there without an appointment. I specially asked if there was a wait because I could come back later. The lady told me no and had me sit in the pedicure chair and had my feet soaked. I waited and waited. My feet was soaked for 45 mins, still on one was free to come even check on me. I just left. I knew I didn't have any appointment. I would have been okay if they told me they were busy and to come back later. I will NEVER go back again!
My favorite spot in town for a classic breakfast. Staff is very friendly. It gets busy during weekends.

Went here for the first time on a Saturday night. Not terribly busy but the rainmaker rodeo was in town. Patio wasn't super clean and kind of in a weird spot. If they cleaned it up or did something with it, it could be a decent sit in the summers, but I wouldn't come for the patio. Food was surprisingly good(or we were hungry)... Nothing special but we just were out for drinks and had the team platter which was bout $30. Probably Enough munchies for 3-4, not amazing value but standard. Hot Wings were meaty but kinda disappointing. steak bites came out fresh and not overdone which is a common problem. Potato skins good, dips good. Also ordered a quesadilla which also came out fresh and delicious. Service was average, but polite. 

Will come back for sure if I'm in st.ab as the inside seems large and has a pool table, foosball table, tv's are newer and unobstructed(unlike original Joe's) Just a solid no nonsense sports pub, and you can never have enough of those around. Probably more of a 3.5 as everything was perfectly adequate, but the food that night was quite solid(for standard pub food) which bumped it up for myself... next time I'll see how consistently solid it is... but if a plain old sports pub is what you're looking for, this would suffice
Extremely bland food. Lasagna tasted like cardboard and thickened milk. Would never go back. Very creepy and annoying owner.

I have been here 3 times now the first two times breakfast nothing special chunky milk and cold I went for lunch had Mexican burger it was good but cold the fry where so cold good service I won't go back tho 3 time cold food each time

This place was really bad. We decided to eat inside and it was terrible. They made our food but it just sat there the person who took my order kept passing by and didn't bother to ask. The baker asked after 10 minutes of waiting on my order. It was made wrong and was cold and hard bread. The baker ended up making both sandwiches over again! Not the soup and sandwich the baker! The salad that was given to us was suppose to be a caesar salad but it had tomatoes no cheese, she tried to make it right but she just added cheese and gave us sauce. I see that they totally focus on their drive thru too much that they ignore the front, having 6-7 people in drive thru and two people up front is simply wrong. Hate to be the a-hole but management has to control where they schedule their people.

The staff at this location are friendly and the restaurant itself has been updated and is quite attractive.

Unfortunately, the overall quality of Wok Box has gone down in the past few years while the prices have continued to rise.

I find the portions and quality is not what I exeperienced 5+ years ago.  On my most recent visit, some of the vegetables were omitted entirely from my noodle dish and the extra $3 I paid to double my protein was hardly noticeable.

I'd much rather support a local mom and pop Vietnamese or Chinese restaurant than this chain.

In a crunch, it's okay but nothing that I would crave or rave about.

I have been here many times for breakfast and am never disappointed in what they have to offer. Like what others have said, staff is friendly and efficient and wait times are not long. This place has been rated best breakfast restaurant for years by the local paper and I couldn't agree more. Check it out, you won't be disappointed!

Pretty disappointed with this pub.  Waitress was ok. Brought us the wrong appetizer to start, and was hard to tag down to indicate this to. When the right appetizer came, the boneless wings were pretty dry.  I ordered lettuce wraps, and extremely disappointed in them. The lettuce was not in very good shape, lots of ripped pieces put together. Chicken part of it just tasted like reheated chicken and salsa mixed. Only good thing to say is their fries and my beer tasted goof. Won't be returning there!

I take my corgi Quinn (aka Quinncess Pwincess) here for all her vet visits and when she got spayed too. I have to say the staff: vet tec's, and reception really make this place. They are so caring and it really shows. When I took her in to get spayed in Jan I was so worried and stressed about her surgery, but the vet tech really made me feel at ease and was just as loving to Quinn as I would be, and I really appreciated that :)

This is the best little Irish pub north of downtown Edmonton. My girlfriend and I love this place. It's "our pub". The beer and spirits selection is above average, although I would like to see more local or craft beer on tap. It's the food and atmosphere that wins us over. It's a very well set up bar. Cozy and quiet but still lively. 

The have a great menu. It's pub food but more inspired. It's very hard to avoid the pot of gold platter, but then the nachos are really great too. Great wait staff, great location. Just an all around great pub.

I have been a customer for the past 15 years and not planning to change.  All the vets and staff there have treated our dogs with the utmost care and attention.  With our one dog, through the skill of the staff, they were able to give her two more years of cancer free life, prior to her passing.  The clinic is always clean, the staff always friendly and the care always superb.  I highly recommend this clinic, especially if you own a dog.

Came to Fantastic Nails and Spa for the first time yesterday with my Mother and Daughter.  We had an appointment for the three of us and we were taken at the promised time with prompt attention.

The staff were friendly and the spa itself - clean.

I will definitely come back :-)

Droooool.....yum yum yummy is all I can say!  A little pricey for frozen milk, but totally worth it!  It is by far the best ice cream I have ever tasted!  you can mix and match toppings(mix-ins) and ice cream.  There are soooo many different flavors you can choose from, and if you can't make up your mind they have a menu of ice cream&mix-in  combinations.

Ah Starbucks. Well once again brand recognition is in full force, looking at the outside I could have been anywhere (Madrid? Penang? Sydney? - nope I was in St. Albert) and the inside has the same cozy, casual feel to it. The store front faces west which is great for our area because that means they get the afternoon/evening sun.

The service is good - not great as sometimes you have to repeat your order or the staff feel the drive-thru takes priority. The food and beverages are exactly what is expected from a Starbucks (that's what you get from a standardized chain) but I find this fact comforting because I know what I order will taste the same no matter where I am in the world. 

I like that there are multiple plug-in locations - on the walls and underneath the bench seat. This is great if you do need to work for a long period of time because then you don't have to fight other people for the limited power.

There are 5 Starbucks locations in St. Albert and this is by far my favorite - for some reason, even for how "out of the box" the store is I really like the feel of this one - it is less busy then others, the staff are always welcoming, and the parking lot is very user friendly. I love to meet up after dinner for coffee with friends throughout the year here.

This is a nice family restaurant, nothing spectacular, but solid service, good food, and reasonable prices. It's a bit far for me to come from South Edmonton, but if I'm already in St. Albert with the family, it's a good destination if we're hungry. 

I've never been here when they've been really busy, but the service in the off times was spectacular. Attentive, but not annoying, and they catered to the kids and were generally happy to see families.

I scream, you scream, we all scream for ice cream! (I know, not original, but here you are still reading.) Marble Slab ice cream is top notch in my books. Yes it is a chain and yes everything is standardized but that is OKAY in this case. That means when I ask for birthday cake flavoured ice cream with skor bits mixed in I will get the exact same delectable taste in my mouth each and every time.

The friendly staff in this location serve with a smile and effectively deal with a long line (including high energy children). I like that there is a frequent customer card (buy 5 ice creams get one free) because they are expensive. I guess the saying you get what you pay for is true!

There is ample parking but limited seating. A downside about this location is that it is hard to get ice cream and go for a walk while you eat it because there isn't anywhere to go except St. Albert trail or the bus terminal. 

No matter the occasion Marble Slab always fills the ice cream craving.

I like this location. The staff was friendly. They had a fair amount of seating and the place wasn't crowded so it was easy to find a seat- that being said I went mid day during the week. They don't have any fancier seating like some starbucks but I don't mind that. The bathrooms weren't great but they weren't bad either- better than quite a few Starbucks I've been to.

We went for a sunday breakfast. No lineup. We believe it was the owner that greeted us. But right after she grabbed the menu...another couple came in...the owner walked right past us..said a big hello to the obvious friends of hers..and proceeded to seat them prior to us. Now we were seated right after...but as both my husband and myself have been in the service industry for over30yrs each...this is a horrible way to treat any customer...will never go back and will tell anyone about situation.  Does not matter that our waitress was extremely good and friendly..1st impressions are everything

Just moved to the area and was looking for a brunch joint. Was very pleased to find Socrates and really enjoyed the meal. Prices were fair and portions were massive. Good atmosphere and staff we're friendly. My ONLY complaint was the shredded hash browns were more like deep friend French fries and not pan fried shredded potatoes. Just my preference so does not reflect overall experience. This will be our new regular place.

It was ok Capital as a whole is a lovely restaurant however this location was not up to par the pizza was soggy and greasy. I truly enjoyed the service the staff was friendly and on top of everything I never had to wait for water or drinks

DONT GO HERE!!

I went for waxing and a pedicure. First off the wax room is disgusting. I should have walked away right  there but really needed to get a brazilian. She never changed the stick each time she dipped it into the wax pot. She burned me pretty bad that i blistered and skin started to peel a few days later. I really wanted to call the health department and complain.
The "Spa" pedicure" is not spa worthy. they pretty much rub deep cold on your legs let it sit and wash it off.
i have nothing good to say about this company.
I wouldn't even rate this if it was an option.

Came here after dinner on my birthday to watch a friend's friend perform.

Nice cozy pub in a strip mall.
Wasn't as busy since was just right after New Year's, so had good service, but can't comment when it's very busy.

I would definitely come back here for a beer and maybe even try their menu.
Came here for some beer after a good deal from manager. Stayed for wings and Oilers game. Fu@#in awesome service and good food! Do it up of your in the area!!!!

This place has gone downhill. Water down coffee and terrible quality food. This was my go to place for breakfast in St. Albert, but it has declined to the quality of a continental breakfast at a cheap hotel.

Sorry Wok Box just because you put your food in those cute little Asian take out boxes doesn't make it good.

Not bad. But not good enough to go back either. And not even good enough to eat the leftovers we brought home (I left them on the fridge all weekend hoping that someone else would eat them but no luck).

I went here the other day for dinner, and I have to say I really like the changes they made to Wok Box. The layout and design are really nice. AND the food is great! They've changed the menu quite a bit, but I defo think its for the better. They now have Indian curries (which I LOVE) and naan bread! But its also fast food, which is great when you need a quick curry fix but don't want to go to a "sit down" restaurant. But they also still have most of the old menu as well, but I think there are some great additions..IMHO at least.

Socrates is pretty hit & miss.  It's been that way at least for the last 5 years.

We went for lunch on Saturday around 1:30. The restaurant was fairly full, but no wait for a table.  The redheaded hostess who "greeted" us definitely needs some customer service training.  I was pretty sure that she hated her job based on her body language, lack of eye contact and no smiling.  When she took us to our table and poured my mom her coffee, she spilled the coffee all over my menu.  She saw it and said "oops" then walked away.  I assumed she was going to get a cloth to wipe it off, but she came back and put my glass of water on the table then walked away again!

So, we shared a menu because mine honestly had a pool on it.

When the waitress came by to take our order, we had to ask for a cloth to wipe the booth down because it was pretty filthy.  I also pointed out the pool of coffee on my menu.  she took our order, took the dirty menu away, and seemed to dismiss the request for a cloth as she walked away without acknowledging it.  However, she returned promptly with a cloth and offered to wipe it down for us.

The waitress was generally pleasant, although she did not check on us during the meal at all, and when she dropped the food off, she didn't ask if we needed anything else.  However, she came back to top off the coffee (but even then, did not ask how everything was).

The food was delicious and everything was cooked perfectly.  And we were sitting close enough to the waitress station that we could have flagged her down if anything was in fact wrong or missing.

The blonde hostess who ended up taking my payment was much more pleasant than the first one, and I left the restaurant feeling full and happy.

Sadly, this was the best visit we've had here in quite a while, which doesn't say too much :( And because of that, I can't bring myself to give more than 3 stars.  But we'll be back.

WOW ..... Poor service!

Don't waste your time. Both a friend and I watched as the server stood and chatted at the bar while we had repeatedly waved to have her come over ( not the first time ) . The Manager ( I think that's who it was ) walked by and just grabbed the plates off the table with out saying a word..... how was you meal did you need anything...... Same service as the first time I was there.  SAD..........

I used to really love the old location that wok box took over. Don't get me wrong, the first time I went there the food was great. But over the years it really has become fast food. I viewed it as more of a restaurant before, but now it's just chinese McDonald's.

Some serious improvements since my last review 6 years ago! 

All ice cream creations now come with unlimited mix-ins. Prices have increased slightly with the smallest at $5.99, regular $6.99, and large $7.99.

My kids prefer marble slab to places like tutti frutti and so does my wallet!  The set prices help.  Beware of extras - a chocolate dipped waffle cone will run you an extra $2 however.  My kids love watching their toppings mixed on the cold marble slab right before their eyes and the quality here really can't be beat.

They also offer tread like brownie sundaes, milkshakes, ice cream cupcakes, banana splits, ice cream cookie sandwiches, and custom cakes (you can even have a photo  put on your cake).

There are often Groupons available which helps to bring the cost down.  Be sure to ask for a frequent visitor stamp card as well. 

On the downside, they have less toppings than years past but I'll take the unlimited mix-in option anytime. 

Usually the kidlets and I bike here on a sunny day for a cold summer treat! 

The line up can be out the door in the summer and they only have 4 small tables inside but c'est la vie. 

Fave combos include: 
birthday cake ice cream, blueberries, & skor
Double dark chocolate ice cream, raspberries, almonds, and chocolate sauce 

See you soon Marble Slab, see you soon!

Great place. They were very comfortable with handling my hamster whose eye was infected and perforated. They prescribed antibiotics and I am happy to say that he is doing well now. They didn't try to push unnecessary surgery on me and gave me advice over the phone when his condition changed. Great place, and very reasonably priced!

Every so often, my son demands that I take him to Joe's for a donair.  It's that good.  Once we saw the owner chasing someone out of the store like Seinfeld's 'Soup Nazi', but she deserved it.  And he's always been great to us!  Delicious sauce, very nice fries ... it's as good as fast food gets!

Stopped in to watch the game and try their famous wings. Outstanding wings and my wife tried the beer braised short rib dinner. It was fantastic too.
Thanks for taking great care of us Walter, we'll see you again soon!

Great spa day!
Ask for Sara
Very professional!
Went out of her way to make sure my spa day was a pleasant experience!!!
Highly recommend!

My favorite breakfast place in town! Always consistent. Very busy place so give your self plenty of time. Can take a while to be seated. Good for lunch and dinner too but breakfast is defiantly the best!

I am a tims junkie. On an average week I am there 11 times. I go to them all over and this one is by far the best. I have a coffee order very straight forward yet everyone messes it up! These guys never do! They are always quick and polite, just a shout out that this is a great Tims!

Good variety of food at a fairly reasonable price. Coffee is ok but not strong enough for me. I had a reuben sandwich on brown which was good. My sister had a breakfest meal and was satisfied. We went on a Wednesday do did not wait too long for our meal.

Prices aren't all that cheap, server was fast enough but kitchen is quite slow getting food out even though it was pretty quiet, 11 a.m. on a Wed. Food quantity was on the light side and quality was just okay. I really object to almost $3 for a cup of not great coffee on top of $12 for basic bacon and eggs. 

Not sure I  would bother going back. Value for what we got wasn't  great.

Lunch really surprised me. 
I've been here for evening drinks and snacks with the crew afterwork. 
I had a Groupon that was just about to expire...so we went in for lunch.
Football game was on, it was quiet in there, maybe a dozen people or so...but when there was something happening on screen, it got a little rowdy. In a good way though.

I tried the Maui Wowie burger. Chicken with ham, cheese and pineapple. I'd have to say it was pretty tasty. Better than I expected. I paired it with their sweet potato fries (also very tasty) but it was the honey dill dip that did me in. I sat there trying to figure out if I could lick out the little sauce cup without anyone watching me. It was finger lickin' good!

The Mr. had a Spicy Chicken Burger. Wasn't too spicy for him and he likened it to a big ol' chicken wing. He seemed to enjoy it. I stole some of his fries. They were cut like no way I've seen before. They were wide, like two fries stuck together. Perfect for dipping in my leftover honey dill sauce. 

Looking at the menu, they have a ton of options for sides, which is great! Not everyone wants fries...some are an easy sub, and others are +$1.50, but to choose from different kinds of potatoes, salad, coleslaw, corn, beans, mac & cheese, onion rings, poutine, chili, soup...how could one not be satisfied?!?!

All in all it was good. Only thing was the menu prices are $2 - $3 more than I would have expected, but I'd say it was worth it.
I love their breakfasts! Its a great local restaurant with delicious food and great service. Would definitely recommend this place for a brunch!

This is my favorite brunch spot in St Albert and even all of Edmonton. 

It has a classic diner appeal. So classic that me and my brunch guest thought it felt similar to Pulp Fiction diner, and we sat in the same spot! "Hunny Bunny.... All right, everybody be cool, this is a robbery. Any of you f$#@ing pricks move, and I'll execute every muthaf$#@ing last one of ya!" Sooo classic!!!

Anyways the food has never let me down so go ahead and order anything you like. I usually only go for brunch or breakfast so don't quote me on the dinners.

A few things to remember... Sunday Brunch doesn't last all day but they do have omlettes that go all day. The best thing is the home fries which are crisp on the outside but soft and warm on the inside.

Get a seat by the booth and replay Pulp Fiction quotes and it'll be as memorable as it is for me!

Overpriced. I'd rather buy a box of Run 'n Raisin from Safeway and eat away. But ice cream is always good, and if I get a 2-for-1 deal, I buy all I can. My favourites are Blueberry, Caramel and Rum. Sometimes the waffle cones can be underdone and taste like raw dough, overdone and brittle or if they run out of regular vanilla waffle cones and offer you an upgrade to a coated waffle cone, it will more likely than not be stale and smell of bad oil, because nobody buys those. The variety is small, both flavours and mixings. No Blueberry or Key Lime flavours, and no Blackberries for fruit mixing. It's a nice quiet location and the staff is usually friendly.

I've been meeting my parents at this restaurant for several years now. It is the brunch hot spot in St. Albert. Every Sunday morning and early afternoon there's a lineup of people eager to eat and socialize. The line may look daunting but the staff are very efficient. 

Pretty much anything you order on the brunch menu is really good. They also have specials which are worth checking out. 

I've eaten here for dinner, too and the food is great. They boast the best prime rib in town. 

The staff are very friendly and efficient. They keep the coffee flowing during brunch.

My boyfriend and I loved this pub when we came here. We had a coupon from the Entertainment Book to try it out and we'll definitely be back. Their food is fresh and delicious. We had fantastic wraps and cold, cold beer - probably one of five of the coldest beers I've had in this city. Also the food portions were big and the prices were reasonable. Another bonus: the glasses didn't smell like sanitizer. My guy works in food safety and he's always noticing that a lot of restaurants don't properly rinse their glasses. This place got a clean bill. The ambiance was cozy, like you want from a slightly upper-scale neighbourhood pub. There was live music when we were there - not too loud, a good sound, nothing intrusive, kinda mellow. It would be fun to go back on the weekend when the place was rockin' a bit. Too bad it's all the way in St. Albert.
Don't let the exterior fool you!  Inside, it is a nice, clean place.  The service is superb and the food is great.  It is a nice breakfast place that is not part of a chain.  Will be back soon!

Sat for over an hour, three tables next to us were seated for fifteen minutes and were served. Asked for water twice and never got any. When the waitress came by and said it was going to be a while longer, we mentioned the long wait and she immediately argued. We then said we were going to leave and she said to bad what ever. Was an older waitress. Horrible service.

The waitress was very friendly, the food was good and it's a nice building inside.

I had the mozza and bacon hot dog with a side of fries and it was great. Service was good and the waitress was knowledgable about the menu which was a bonus. 

Overall I like beer hunter a lot, it's a great place to have a beer and watch the game and I've never been disappointed by their food.

I've only been here on weekend evenings and it was pretty busy both nights. I'd say it's the most happening bar/pub in St Albert that I've seen so far. 

I was able to get a seat to watch UFC152 in Toronto and watch Jon Bones Jones almost get submitted then turn it around and submit Belfort. I ordered a double Vodka/Soda in a tall glass and it was $8.75 which wasn't bad. I nursed that while watching 5 rounds of the first Flyweight final and the headliner. 

I'll probably keep coming here to watch UFC since it's close and they always show it.

Love, love, LOVE my Starbucks - it's not secret.

This location offers up all the standard Starbucks fare but it's a tad smaller than most and the parking is limited :-(  You can only get into it from the St. A Trail or Bellerose Drive on one side of each road because it's in a high traffic area.  Consequently, it can take a little extra time compared to some of the more readily accessible locations.

Be sure to download the Starbucks App to your smart phone in order to earn stars for every purchase (Buy 12 get 1 free) and offers and discounts that are offered exclusively to the App holders such as an extra hour on Frappy 50% off days, B1G1 free from time to time, or the more frequently offered $1 off an espresso beverage.  

You can also put money on your app, link it to a gift card, or register for auto load with a credit card so that you can conveniently pay on your phone!

One tip if you're trying to get to Gold member status or earn more stars, request to pay for your purchases separately so that you can earn a reward star for each transaction.

Another thing is remember you can customize the drinks anyway you like.  For example, you can get a Frappuccino made your way - it's doesn't have to be made with the sugary base.  You can ask for it to be made with decaf espresso or made with dark roast coffee, milk of your choice, ice and a sugar free syrup if you want to go sugar free.   You can google all kinds of Starbucks off shelf or secret menu ideas/recipes for your next visit!  And if you're doing a LCHF diet, remember that you can always ask for your lattes or fraps to be made with half and half, heavy cream or whipping cream!  If you order any of their drinks as a "Breve" they will make it with half and half rather than milk.  

The point is, customize the drinks to what YOU want!

Ever since I have been going to see Amie I have enjoyed the customer service,she her staff give, she always looks after me, from time to time my son loves sitting in the spa chairs, use the remote control for his back due he is growing so fast, he makes the girls laugh,  they are very friendly I would recommend them to anyone that asks where I get my nails done I proudly tell them where I get them done

There's a reason that Socrates has been voted "Best Breakfast" in St. Albert by the local newspaper for years and years in a row.

Lots of parking, plenty of seating, and the coffee is always nice and hot.

It's a very big breakfast menu. I ordered my favourite, the waffles, with one of my besties (we have a long-standing waffle tradition). You can order the waffles as part of a larger breakfast combo with sausage, bacon, hashbrowns, and toast for less than $13. Plus, fresh strawberries and whippped cream on top!

Whenever I'm back in my hometown, this is the only spot I go for breakfast, period.

Great staff. The place doesn't look like much, kind of stocked in the 90's. But they have solid cooking base,  not scare of food poisoning and they have strong coffee. Must try the shredded hashbrowns, the best I had in the Edmonton area.

The atmosphere is what you would expect of a pub called the beer hunter. But that's about where it ended. The staff was incredibly friendly and we noticed that customers were treated like long time friends. The food also surprised us! We had a meat and cheese platter to go without wine and it was well thought out and super tasty! The spiciest cheese I've had in a long time!

This would be an awesome place to hang out with friends for an evening and eat and drink!

Came again today for the 4th time in 5 weeks... Yes, they are that good! We usually come on Sundays but he doesn't make chicken Donairs on Sundays so we popped in today, on Saturday, to specifically try his most favorite creation!

He offers is up with lettuce, pickles, tomatoes, olives, onions and your choice of a homemade garlic sauce (mayo based) and a homemade tzatziki (heavy on the fresh dill).  

Bill, the owner, advised that the chicken Donair is his most favorite creation on his menu. 

We opted for the tzatziki chicken Donair and my hubby devoured it!  I'm not a big fan of dill so I'd probably opt for the Donair sweet sauce (usually served with beef Donairs).

We also had my favorite today, a cheese & beef Donair! I call it "meat heaven" which makes my husband laugh because I was a vegetarian when we met!

Everything here is delicious - if you haven't been to Joe's, do yourself a favor & bookmark this shop! The food is fresh, filling, & never greasy!

As a side note, both hubby and I have never had a pita this good anywhere! His Pitas are so freaking fluffy and warm.  His Donairs are given just the right amount if sauce (if you LOVE your Donair to drown in sauce, be sure to ask for extra).

We love Joe's Famous Donairs!!!

(Just remember, the owner's name is Bill)

Donair Meat check. Sweet Sauce check. 

Joe's has good consistent donairs. Nothing special or out of the box but good every time you go. Even the regular size donair is too big for me to finish, unless I want a stomach ache. 

The best thing about Joe's is their pop selection, they have some exotic drinks that I thought were extinct! The variety would make me come back just to try a new one each time. :)

i have been coming to socrates since i was little in 17 now and still am going! I love the food and the staff are so nice and welcoming. I took my boyfriend here and he loves it the food is amazing! A long wait witch on saturday mornings but you get in quite quick would 100 percent recommend & would give it 10 stars if i could

Great breakfast place, ive been a regular for years. Great food but I'm always surprised that a place with high quality food standards would have such bitter coffee. Its hit and miss as far as servers go. There's a couple older gals that have been there for years and honestly if i had a choice I'd rather not have them.

Yum yum yummy! Where else can you have fresh made ice cream mixed with toppings right before your eyes?

The reason I love Marble Slab is because I am a big fan of fruit on my ice cream.  Normally fruit would be frozen in your ice cream at say Baskin Robbins or the grocery store. But at Marble Slab they mix it in fresh! So raspberries retain their both their tartness & juiciness!  For me this is great because my favorite concoction is Dark Chocolate ice cream with Raspberries & Almonds!

My hubby's favorite is definitely one you wouldn't find in a grocery store! Birthday Cake ice cream with Blueberries & Skor pieces!  Might sound a little weird - but it is delish!

The prices are a little high - but for a specialty treat made just your way it's worth every penny!

They also do specialty cakes and cupcakes!!! Mmm... Mmm... Good!

Well I had not been to O'Maille's in a very very long time.  I think there has been a couple of ownership changes since the last time I was there.

It's a cozy little place...lots of seats.  Never really seems to be very busy.  We had first gone somewhere else for Brunch on Saturday, forgetting that there was a game on.  Our first choice was packed full with people watching the game.  So drove around for a bit, trying to think of something else, when I finally remembered our old standard.  So, off we went.

It was surprisingly empty.  Only a handful of tables were occupied.  Which was great because service was fast and efficient.

Our server was really friendly, and the food came out exactly as ordered.  The brunch menu was boring, but allowed us to get the bacon and eggs that we were looking for.  Personally, I was craving Poutine and there's really hit the spot.  There's something about the gravy that was so good... I'll go back for that, if nothing else.

When I was younger, this was a decent place to catch a local live act, but I'm not sure if that's the case anymore.  Either way... I'll be back more often.

I had to come here because my favorite cafe (little bean) is closed on Sunday's. I used the drive thru which is a nice feature and the drink was made to my specifications so I really can't complain. But recently I've been trying to stay away from any chain retailer. I know this is pretty much impossible but with Starbucks they also burn their coffee beans which ruins the espresso. Also the automation of the whole process takes something away from the quality. Just for example, I would NEVER order a Espresso Macchiatto from them.

Went in for three specialty cones that you can only get here...
But "sorry we don't have that...sorry there's none of that....sorry we are out of that....sorry there's none of that left either..."   etc etc.


We ended up leaving with three plain chocolate and one vanilla cone in 1980's style cheapo cones...$20 lighter than when we went in.


Better quality for the price just picking up the supplies you want at Save-On across the parking-lot.and making it at home.

Overpriced fad that we will not be supporting any more.

BRUTAL EXPERIENCE! Since management change in November 2013, O'mallies has gone down hill. I booked a Xmas party for 50 people. Once I arrived at 9pm, the Manager Shawn said he was closing at 12am. This was not discussed previously. At 12am, he kicked out over 70 guests without doing "last call." My girlfriend politely asked if he could possibly stay open for another hour. She was then verbally assaulted by Shawn as he began to swear and yell at her. His bouncer/dish washer then began to threaten guests with violence. I felt bad for the waitresses,  because their service was amazing all night.They would miss out on large tips because of how unprofessional the other staff was. I've been going to O'mallies for years, but will not return until management is changed

I had a problem in the drive thru and the staff were not that helpful.  The owner called me and was defensive even before the conversation started. The orders are seldom correct they miss items quite frequently , there seems to be poor leadership and guidance with the staff.

This place just keeps giving me reasons to keep coming back!! Tonight while  on my mobile scooter I stopped and talked to Bert (homeless man that hangs out at gateway village) and learned he had nothing to eat today. I went through the drive thru and ordered a sandwich and coffee for him only to find out I didn't have enough $ to cover it myself. I'm disabled and on social assistance myself but I figured I had $11 in my account. Nope. 

Jordan, the lad at the window was very patient as I told him (embarrassed) it wasn't for me and who it was for and he said just take it. I hope he doesn't get in trouble for that but I was just touched that he'd do that. Regardless this location has given me more reasons to celebrate the kindness that still can be found in the hearts of ppl and this has been my favorite location for a couple decades now and it stands out in my community as so much more than just a simple coffee shop. Thank you Jordan and Tim hortons Gateway village. I'll be by on Friday to settle up my bill.

Disappointment, went here expecting a great donair but it wasn't. Meat was soggy and pita was crunchy and the sauce was gross. The salad was was watery and the croutons were to soggy to enjoy. For 13 dollars i could have gone to simply donair and had a way better experience. Never going again.
If you are looking for fast service don't eat here. The food is good and reasonably priced but it took 10 min to get our order placed.
This is a great place to sit back relax and have a beer. The pool table and darts is almost always open and the specials are pretty great.

I just left today on a Sunday we went in at 630pm. Upon walking in there was two people in line and one person sitting at the table eating within two minutes we gave our order and we proceeded to sit and wait. What we observed over the next 30 mins was infuriating. There was two young ladies working but only one young lady ever worked the wok, the other just stood there talking to her and distracting her. We watched the save the dishes delivery guy come in and out and picked up about 7 diffrent orders within a 30 minute period, yet we were still waiting on our order along with one other person that was standing in front of us in line. My husband got up after a full 30 mins to ask how much longer it would be and the lady proceded to tell us that it was just them two working and that they were really behind on Save the dishes orders. I then spoke up and said the save the dishes shouldn't take precedence over your walk in clients. It's supposed to be fast food. This is when she walked to the back and asked the wok girl to start yes START making our order which she proceeded to do I then asked if I could speak with the manager to which she replied she was and told me her name I think it was amal I couldn't quite get her accent. I said why couldn't you just tell us when we ordered that it was going to be a 30 min wait if you knew you were behind. She just shrugged her shoulders. The worst display of management and just all together customer service that I've ever seen. We are huge fans of wokbox and now because of this experience we will never be going back. I would give it zero Stars if I could.
I'm shocked that this location wasn't in here yet!  It's a staple for us whether it be an after soccer timbits treat or a Mommy Daughter bevvie date!  Drive thru is always fast!

The last four times I've eaten here my order has been incorrect and the coffee has tasted horribly stale. The workers are also incredibly rude and are often snarky for absolutely no reason; however, it's very clean and the orders are put out quickly.

Great service and awesome food!! Their breakfast was great. I was shocked at how busy it was, they had a line up going out the door. Made me realize how amazing the place really was. 

It is a family run business and again I love that. They actually care about their customers satisfaction. I wish there were more places like this in Edmonton.

Last time I'll be eating here.. firstly the water glass had lipstick on it.. then we ordered appetizers and lunch, our server forgot to ring in appys and our lunch sat under the heat lamps so the food came out cold. After we were finished eating our appetizers came out (hot) but we were still charged for appys though it was the servers mistake.. food was mediocre and service wasn't existent. So my business will be somewhere else going forward.

My hubby and I are frequent diners at Socrates for breakfast/bruch/lunch. We go there at least once or twice a month and have always had pretty great service and food quality. This is a place that you would drive by a ton of times and always wonder how the food actually is. It's definitely worth stopping by! 

My SO always gets the same thing, eggs, bacon, toast and hash browns and he's always impressed with the portion sizes and the quality. 

I'm more adventurous and have ordered a variety of items off their breakfast menu. My favorite so far are the BCO Eggs Benedict. Love that one! But I've also had the pancakes, scramblers, and recently had their Bacon Cheeseburger. The burger was pretty amazing! Tasted great, the bun was perfectly sized to match the burger (believe it or not, that is important), the ingredients were fresh, lots of cheese and bacon and I would order it again! It was a little bit overcooked, but that's pretty common, so I don't hold that against them. 

They recently did an interior renovation. Updated the chair covers and table tops so it looks nice. If you go at peak times, you will have to wait, but even when I've gone with 6 people, we've never had to wait more than 20 mins. 

There isn't a whole lot of staff turnover there either which is nice to see. And they do wonderful catering! (I've ordered some for business meetings). 

I've read some of the previous reviews, and while I can't speak how a full dinner entree is, I've seen some of the lunch items ordered (sandwiches, burgers, salads) and they look pretty amazing. 

Overall....we love Socrates and will keep going!

Staff was nice. Reasonably clean. Nothing fancy.  Family style. Not cheap. 

Ordered veal cutlet with creamy mushroom soup, baked potato and veggies. Creamy mushroom soup was basically an over thickened (could taste some flour chunks) chicken stock with mushrooms added.  Salty!  Potato and veggies came out cold. Cutlet...came in two thin pieces with gravy on top. One piece was nice. The other was tough and way over cooked.  So....they brought new veggies and a hot baked potato.  The second cup of coffee was hot. 

At the end they knocked off $7 on the bill since both of us ordered the exact same thing and had the exact same problem.

Stopped here for the first time since moving to St.Albert one year ago. We had heard from some people that there breakfast is very good. We had dinner there and I had the veal and my wife had spinach ravioli. Unfortunately the meal was not very good and we left just about all our meal on the plate then we paid and left. We will not be going back! Service was good but very slow!

Great little Mom & Pop family diner. They were voted best breakfast in St. Albert last year and their busy weekend mornings with lines out the door are proof!

I found their food average for a breakfast diner - they have great weekday breakfast specials before 10am.

The service is always efficient and friendly! 

I've never tried them for lunch or dinner... I'll yelp about it when I do!

If you are looking for breakfast in St. Albert - this is a great place with that Mom & Pop feel!

I don't like this location staff. They don't know how to make coffee. I ordered ice coffee more than 3 times. Always, coffee is overflowing. I dropped coffee in my shirts. And then, one of staff who is working drive thur very very UNKIND. Even though this Starbucks is very close to from my place, I'm Not going there. Never Ever !!

We have eaten here several times and have always had good results.

It is a great "go to" restaurant when you are not sure what you want to eat as there is great variety on the menu.

The portions of the food are generous, it is tasty and fresh, and consistently good.

The staff are excellent here. They always seem friendly, and seem to enjoy working there. No complaints at all.

We go here about once every 1-2 months and have yet to have a bad experience. Highly recommended!

There are good and bad things about Socrates, but the bad ones triumph by far.

The parking lot and location for the restaurant are stupid. Every time I go there I probably end up waiting 5 minutes to turn left. 

The tables are really nice, but once you sit down it takes about 3 seconds to realize that you have a "wonderful" view of st.albert trail.

The staff don't care about you as a customer. They take your order, hope they don't mix it up, give you your food then they leave. You have to go up to the front just to get a re fill of coffee.

Socrates, not reccomended
Delicious food, foods always fresh and hot, large portions, great service! Best poutine I've ever had.

I've been going here for years. Likely 20 yrs now that I think about. One employee that stands out and always has is named Prime. She's always been pleasant and in recent conversation with her she's been there 10 yrs!! But in all honesty what I love is that they'll serve me in the drive thru with my big dog on a leash beside me while I'm on my mobility scooter. Being disabled sucks, these guys make life a little more pleasant. Tims coffee is ok,  but for this reason alone ill never go anywhere else.

We try to eat here whenever we can but if there is a line we take off. In general the staff is the rudest I have seen in the greater Edmonton region.  They always seem so busy and have no patience for the customer. Some of the servers remind me of the "Soup Nazi" from Seinfeld.  

Upon leaving this morning without ordering the lady ahead of us who was hanging in there said "your lucky if you get a grunt if you ask a question"

I always wonder if the owner is present and they think this is acceptable or they just own it and lunatics are running the asylum. 

So in summary. Great food, Grumpy service.

Had a great breakfast. I was a little skeptical coming here based on the pictures of the leprechaun cakes in the photos but the breakfast was excellent. It's a great old fashioned diner. I had the signature breakfast and was very satisfied. The pancakes were a nice balance between spongy and fluffy which are my favorite. Hash browns were cubed and cooked perfectly. They didn't seem "house-made" but we're still great. Bacon was a little thin but I've been used to thick Costco bacon at home so it's not a really fair comparison.

They have a great diner ambiance and the decor was clean and pleasing. The outside of the building is a bit dated and weathered but don't let its appearance keep you away. All of the staff were professional, fun and very friendly. 

I haven't had a chance to try lunch and dinner but I'm definitely jonesing for their lasagna!

Socrates management has lost all comprehension of what it means to please the customer first.

This past Fathers day Sunday my wife and I drove 40 minutes passing numerous other restaurants just so I could order their blueberry pancakes that I have enjoyed in the past.

 We arrive shortly after 1pm and are seated in the 1/2 full restaurant. The waitress takes a long time to come around but eventually shows up and my wife is asked her order first and orders bacon and eggs.

 Immediately the waitress states we are to late for bacon and eggs we have to order off the lunch/dinner menu.

 We didn't want lunch we wanted breakfast just like we've had numerous times before on Sunday early afternoon's at Socrates. 

We decide to leave and end up just down the block at Ricky's and got the breakfast that we wanted.

 I found it odd that Socrates quit offering breakfast Sunday afternoon's so when I got home I checked their menu online. What I discovered was they do in fact offer bacon and eggs but you can only get them in combination with a waffle or french toast.

 Price was not the issue for us. If we had been offered that option instead of just saying "we don't serve bacon on eggs" my wife would have just said hold the waffle but that was never offered.

 Instead of Socrates making $35.00 plus from our order Ricky's instead got it. 

Not only did Socrates lose the money they lost my loyalty and future business.

 It boils down to the greed and arrogance of the owners. They don't understand the concept give the customer what they want and they will return time after time. Piss off a customer and you lose them forever.

I can't believe that I've been going to this outlet for years, but have only checked in once! 

I have never, EVER had a problem or even an issue at this location. It is always nice and clean, and the staff is always friendly and courteous. 

Over the years, I swear I've tried darn near everything on the menu at one time or another. I can honestly say that I've never eaten anything that I truly disliked. Some things are better than others according to my palette, but overall I do enjoy their food. 

After being diagnosed as diabetic, I now mostly enjoy a large black coffee, occasionally indulging in a Timbit or two or an Ice Cap with a shot of mint on a hot day.

The main reason that I wanted to write this review is because of a couple of negative reviews by the same gentleman, made in 2013. He said in both reviews that the coffee tasted like it was burnt. I, for one, have always enjoyed Timmies coffee, and never once thought it tasted "burnt." Which leads me to my next question... how do you "burn" coffee? Granted, this gentleman may have encountered a bad batch of coffee beans that the restaurant may have ordered and that may have been the reason for his reviews. 

I think that this Tim Hortons deserves more than a 3 star review. Hopefully you in reading this, will think so too.

Great food, service good busy on Saturday/Sunday

Good breakfast menu, good selection

The breakfast special until 11 AM on weekdays is great value considering tea that costs $225 or more by itself, or coffee, is included in the $7.25 price for two eggs, sausages or bacon, hash browns and toast. If you order egg whites only, they will literally give you a quantity that is the contents of two eggs without the yolks, so order four eggs if you want the gross quantity of two eggs. The additional eggs I believe are $150 each. Service is acceptable to good, depending on the server. Apparently the server gets your money and they in turn pay the restaurant.

The waitress was very friendly and thoughtful.  The pizza was good. But the lady at the till was extremely nasty.  She took our bill without saying anything, not even asking how it was or how much we owed. Gave us a change and still said nothing, not even a smile.

The staff here is hit and miss. Sometimes you get someone friendly and sometimes you dont. The manager here is the worst. The last time I went to the drive thru here I had to have her at the window. Even when you go out of your way to smile she is cold and bitchy back. Wont go here again

My friend and I went for dinner and were very disappointed in the quality of food.  I ordered a senior turkey dinner and was given bits of turkey , maybe a tsp of turkey chopped up and hidden under the stuffing on top.  Maybe a tablespoon of stuffing on top.  I looked under the stuffing and there was a. bit if dried turkey with the skin.  I really should  of returned  it right there then.  I didn't say anything as I suggested Socrates for. Dinner.  The breakfast has always been great but the dinner is very disappointing.  My husband and his friend has hamburger steak and they didn't enjoy it as they both said it was terrible gravy.  We would not go back fir dinner unless the quality of food improves.

The last time was the third and...well...last time.

Ordering a sandwich 'dry, no sauce' comes back with a different kind of sauce each time (only at this location).  

Oh...and do not order the crispy chicken!  Rubbery texture, impossible to chew and the furthest thing from crispy.  Old, chewy and just gross.

What happened Timmies?  New management or lack of?

So disgusted in my recent visit to this St Albert Wok Box. I ordered Thai Curry and paid. The guy serving at the front counter did not wash his hands after handling my money and the change he handed back to me. He also did not wear gloves when he proceeded to cook. I watched and he did not appear to handle any of the food he prepared, but at the end he walked over to the counter and used his fingers to pluck a lime, bean sprouts, and cilantro out of bins and sprinkle onto my box of to go food. I just think it is so gross this day and age to neither wash your hands when dealing with a combination of money and food, nor to use gloves. Who knows what he was doing in the back before he came out to the front after I rang the counter bell. I will NEVER go back here. That little box of food went directly into the garbage.

Drive-thru here is really frustrating. First, as soon as you pull up before you can even begin to order they open with a hard-sell "what can we warm up for you to eat", or "can we get you some egg bites". I find this really obnoxious and overkill. Just ask me what I would like and let me take the lead please. Once you do order it's usually slow and half the time wrong. Today the till went down and when I got to the window the barista actually asked me to GIVE HER MY DEBIT CARD so that she could go and tap it in another location without me! When I refused, she then told me to go and park out front and come inside to pay. I handed back my drink and said no thanks, not what a drive-thru is for. Terrible customer service.

Offer me ice cream and I'm all yours.   Offer me  fruit, nuts and candy pieces mixed in while I watch, and I'll even wash windows!   (Well, okay, probably not, but you get the idea!).
