Do not use this people.  They are very cocky and arrogant in their customer services.  Once they got your money they don't return you emails or calls.  They take no responsibilities for theirs actions.  I would not use them as a contractor.  They do not care as customers come to them.

We wouldn't use Pro-tec Roofing again.  

Quality was poor and also, they caused many problems in our neighbourhood with playing extremely loud music which could be heard blocks away.  

When neighbours asked them to turn it down, they were very mean, refused and taunted the neighbours - even turning the music louder and gave the finger and other profanities.  They said that it happens all the time with neighbours complaining about the music around the houses that they roof and they can do what they want.  We were very embarrassed since we kept hearing about it from our neighbours afterwards.  We also realized that we do not want to do future business with a company of this type of character.

Also, they had a crew of 5 people none of who were wearing harnesses or other safety gear.  I am not sure if there is an incident if one of them slips and gets injured, whether the homeowner who hires them is liable.  This made us a bit worried.

I also just checked their BBB review and noticed that they had several complaints in the past year which is not a good sign.

I'll be honest, I'm not crazy about Farmers Markets but I have been to almost all of them around the Edmonton area and the St. Albert Market is the best. Compared to the others, it's for sure the largest and also has the most variety of goods offered from your standard produce vendors to homemade crafts to more unique vendors that sell greeting cards. The number of stalls at this market is almost overwhelming but definitely doable. There's something about Farmers Markets that, on a nice day, everyone seems to be having a great time.

We took our kids (2,4 and 6) to Nello's tonight and had a great experience. We shared a calamari appetizer and two pastas and it was plenty for the 5 of us. Food was quick (maybe because we got there just after they opened at 5 and ordered quickly) and our server Kim and her helper were outstanding, especially with the kids. I would highly recommend! The menu looks pricy at first glance but the portions are very generous and suitable for sharing. $65 including tip for the whole family (with no alcohol). We will be back!

Excellent food - a little pricey , but worth it.
Waitress was good, a little "reserved", but adequate.
Atmosphere was pleasant, restaurant was clean.
I would eat there again.

The usual Starbucks. Just a little slower at this particular moment. 

Fairly clean. Not spotless.

Nello's might not look like too much from the outside, but don't let the strip mall front fool you! Nello's offers traditional Italian dishes, such as veal parmigiana, and healthy portions of pasta! 

My family came here, and as a group of six, we split an order of 1lb mussels comfortably between us. My main (chicken arrabiata) was well cooked - the pasta was perfectly al dente, and the sauce had the perfect amount of spice.

As mentioned, portions are large, so plan to take some home!

This is a cozy restaurant, we met some friends for dinner and ended up sharing a bottle of wine with our bruschetta and calamari which was great! The calamari was not rubbery what so ever, yum. 
After the appetizers were finished we decided to have another bottle of wine to share, this time we ordered a " Ruffino - Chianti Classico Riserva Ducale " which was very light bodied and had hints of cherry. 
Our waitress was awesome, she had fun serving us and could joke around. It was refreshing and made the evening even more pleasant. 
Once our entrees came I realized we all order very different items: lobster, lamb, veal, and puttanesca for myself. It was very good, and everyone was silence while eating which means they really enjoyed their dishes.
Toward the end of the evening we went through one last bottle of wine but I can't remember the name of that one.......I'm a bit of light weight when it comes to drinking. 
It was a great evening.
Enjoy your pasta.

Unbelievable!!!!!! Fabulous!!!! Fantastic!!!!!!
Food was delicious!!!!! Service was impeccable!!!!!
Very nice small comfortable little restaurant!!!!!
Everyone needs to come here !!!!

This was a pleasant dining experience. Beautiful view, excellent service. However I felt the food was below par. The wine list was excellent. This place has character...but lacks in the quality of food for the price! 
Enjoyable, although I wouldn't go back.

Took my mom there for her birthday.   Great location and decor but service and portions just didn't cut it for the price.   I have no issue paying for fine dining but small portions and waiting close to 50 minutes to get our food is unacceptable.  No doubt a beautiful room but won't be on my list for our next outing.
Delicious pasta! My husband and I both loved what we ordered. I had the veal ravoli and it was amazing! Large portions and good service. The decor is out dated but it was charming!

While I can see the previous reviewer's point of view - especially in regards to meat - I will not buy meat at Clareview Superstore after several poor experiences... and I still don't make any Superstore my regular location for meats.  

I do love their JOE fresh line of clothes - super inexpensive and perfect for babies, toddlers, and light summer wear!  We SWEAR by their PC Green brand diapers - works WAY better than some of the more expensive diapers we had been buying at Planet Organic and the like...

Best prices for pop, cereal, crackers... all those kinds of foods that I'm not worried about with how it's being handled (meat, dairy, etc.)

We also swear by their PC Green brand cat litter made from pine product - lighter and cheaper and works better than the Green brand we had been buying at Petsmart for years!

The gentleman that runs the lotto booth at this location is super friendly and the bakery staff always cheerfully give my toddler a cookie when we shop there.

They also have the best prices in town on my favorite 100% fruit juice popsicles and black beans (which can be kinda hard to find sometimes).

Check out times at this location are usually less than 10 minutes - it's a smaller store and not crowded like some of the other locations (i.e. You couldn't pay me to ever shop at the Clareview one again!)

I'll still stick to Costco for my meats & dairy... but PC all the way for diapers, cat litter, non-perishables, and clothes!

The food is always delicious, and the service is great. That is if your not wearing a hat and are dressed 'appropriately'...and have NO kids :S  Yes the signs on the door are cold, but once your inside it's warm and cozy.
Other than that the food is really fantastic.  But since we have had children, we haven't been able to enjoy any of Nellos entrees :(  Too bad.

Our family continues to rely on Superstore for fresh produce and the Joe Fresh brand.  When you are outfitting wee ones or purchasing organic baby products including diapers, the prices here cannot be beat!  And if you have a kitty, you NEED to try their Superstore cat litter - Green brand!  I can't say enough good things about it - super light weight and pine smelling.  MeOw!

The bakery staff are always there with a friendly smile to give a young child a cookie :-)

This store had a significant remodel in the last year and is now quite bright and cheery.

There is a PC financial located inside if that's your bank of choice.

There is also a gas bar outside that has propane for your last minute tank fills and a liqour store as well.

A wonderful cozy Italian place on St. Albert Trail towards the north part of St. Albert. This restaurant has some pretty incredible food and a very charming atmosphere. The portion sizes will keep you in leftovers for a while but that adds to the charm of the place. You can almost hear the old Italian grandmother telling you to "eat! eat!" because you are too skinny when clearly you are not. But wow...great food.

Potenially one of the Coolest additions to the Edmonton landscape is the Enjoy Centre, and the Resto here almost lives up to the rest of it. I really get disappointed when a room is beautifully designed, imaculately designed, and the food is purposefully sloppy to have some eco credit, and the service is purposely snooty, like the steady diet of wheatgrass and spirulina had erased the manners and social graces. 

there comes a point when a locally focused place becomes glib and snotty, like the Yogi that flaunts how aligned there shakras are, and Prairie bistro does this. Yes, i get the novelty about listing where your ingredients come from, but the menu is more a laundry list of farmers then a tantilizing card. 

all in all, the food was tasty, but missed the mark, mostly because they really tried hard to avoid elegance, and balance, and contrast, and interest. 

beer list was good, but they were out of the two I wanted, so i felt a bit slighted

i dunno, maybe tyhe point is to be sloppy and glib, but its not my flavour.

I have been bringing my older dog, Abby to Clippin Along for the past 5 years or so, and now I bring both of my Bichons to them. (Abby and Annie). With our first dog, we had tried 2 or 3 other places, and we haven't changed once since going to Clippin Along!  The staff at Clippin Along are so friendly, outgoing and treat our dogs just like their own pets. Our girls are always so excited to go there! 

If there were any problems during the cuts, someone would call to verify if it was okay to proceed and they always call when the dogs are almost done being groomed. The rates are comparable to anywhere else, and their service is what really makes them stand out from any other groomer. 
We never have any worries taking our dogs there, and always know they're in great care. 
Thanks to everyone at Clippin Along for doing such a fabulous job!

We went here on a groupon and probably wouldn't have bothered if it had not been for the discount. This place is hella expensive.

But, with the groupon it was worth the price. The food was superior, and the service was perfect. 

Would maybe go again without the groupon but only on a very special occasion as the prices are up there. The food is well worth it, though. 

It was pretty busy for a Tuesday night, yet the food came out quick and was fresh. Portions are huge. And it is very tasty. Lots of nice flavors!

One of my favourite locations, they always say hello as I enter, and goodbye when I leave. 
They've learned my first name, and always remember I have an allergy to dairy! What more could I ask for?!

Stopped at St. Albert superstore, picked up  some groceries, when I got to the cashier, she asked how many bags I wanted, told her two, she rang up my groceries, told me how much the total was, I was bagging everything and she kept telling me the total, She saw that I had a hard time because my one hand is sort of handicapped. You'd think she would help, but no, she just kept telling me what the total was. I told her that I was trying to bag my purchases. she said, "well, this is an express lane". So what?. Being ignorant and rude is no excuse. I was on the verge of just telling her I didn't want the stuff.  I noticed the sign after that it said 1 - 12 express, and I had a whole 16 items. No line up. Just me.  Nope. never again.

Came here with my husband last night. Nice atmosphere. Food was delish. I got the gnocchi and it was amazing. I don't find it overpriced for the amount of food you get either. Service was great. Only thing that was strange was you can't get money back on a gift card. So if your gift card is for 75$ you need to use it all because they won't credit the change back to the gift card. I've never seen anything like that before. 

All in all I would come back for sure!

This is probably my favorite in the Edmonton area. I have come twice with a Groupon and gotten the lamb both times. It is some of the best rack of lamb I have had in Alberta and a very generous portion. 
The gnocchi isn't the best I have had, but it is quite good. I recommend to all my friends.

Had a Teambuy coupon to use ($30 for $60) so took a friend on a Friday evening to check out the original location (other location is on South side).  Took a few wrong turns to find the place but eventually found it.  They don't let you make reservations (unless you are a group of 6 or larger) which is weird but when we arrived at 7:15pm, only had to wait a few minutes for them to get a table set up.

We decided to split three dishes:

1) Prawns alla Nello's ($21) - 8 prawns and their version of risotto.  It's not the typical risotto that you expect but was still good.  The prawns were cooked perfectly and presentation of the dish was excellent.

2) Gnocchi dish ($15) - stuffed with potatoes in a cream sauce.  Could use something else in this dish to spice it up. A bit to plain.

3) Penne saporito ($22) - penne noodles in a tomato cream sauce with brocolli, chicken breast pieces and parmigiana.

4) Creme brulee ($9) - nice creamy, smooth texture and crunch on the top. Only weird thing is that we both tasted a bit of banana flavour in it. Not sure why they would have put this in - was it on purpose or accident? Anyways, luckily it wasn't overpowering but it was still there lingering in the background.

This place is definitely on the more expensive side (most pasta dishes were $20-30) but the amount of food that they give you is huge.  We definitely had leftovers to bring back home.  As other people have said, service is on the slower side - our waiter was a nice guy but kept on creeping up on us to talk to us/deliver dishes and then was chatting with two girls at another table when we wanted to get the bill.  Not sure if their prices are worth what they serving up here but I'd say it's decent at best. Worth a try but not sure if I'll go back anytime soon.

Not the best atmosphere....in fact its not nice at all... very weird actually
Food however, fantastic.  You have to wait a good while for meal to be prepared but at least we knew it was being cooked fresh. 
It is an expensive dinner for sure but quality is fantastic
Portions are massive
We actually have take out these days so not to sit in and have it on our comfy sofa! lol

On a recommendation from a friend we decided to try out Nello's for a decent Italian meal. We went early because we heard they get quite busy and we didn't have reservations. Upon entering it didn't "appear" to be an expensive place to eat, as it's part of a strip mall, but we knew from our friend that a good meal would probably be around $100. I ordered a Zinfidel, Salmon and angel hair pasta. My hubby had the gnocci and ordered a soda. The salmon was tasty although there were a few small bones and skin, the pasta and sauce was great. My hubby enjoyed his meal, but the waiter forgot the soda, and I only planned on ordering one glass of wine, but noticed that the waiter poured a second glass at the same time mine was poured and left it up on the counter (for almost 2 hours) so I never did order a second glass because I didn't want to get stuck with a warm glass of wine. The desert (Homemade Tiramisu) was the best part of the whole meal. The owner comped the desert since my hubby never got his drink. Overall we were very happy with the food, the location could use a larger sign (off on the road) to make it super easy to locate. We chatted with the owner which was cool. I think the inside could use a little more atmosphere - separate the entrance from the dining area and maybe dim the lights a bit to make it more away from the main busy road of St Albert Trail.
Good food but the waitress Kimmy was terrible in customer service. Have been there for a few times and will not return.

I appreciate the Mr. Lube business model, but I've started getting anxiety when thinking about taking my car back there after the experience I had with another location recently.  The pressure can sometimes be confusing and overwhelming if you don't know much about cars.

Anyway.... I decided to give it another try at another location.  When I arrived around noon on Sunday, the two bays were occupied and there was a vehicle in line at each of them.  So I pulled my car up behind them to begin my wait.  One thing I've noticed after going to 3 or 4 locations now, is that some will run out to greet you, and offer a beverage or newspaper while you wait, while others will not.  This location does not.  But I don't actually care.

The tech working in the bay I went into was Dan.  There were no uncomfortable sales pitches and he didn't try to make me feel like a neglectful car owner.  He was efficient and fast and made sure I knew what he was doing at every step.

I would come back here for sure.

Maybe we had a different waitress, or maybe simply a good day for the restaurant, but our service was friendly and timely.  From start to finish, we were in there roughly an hour, food was hot, and featured the expected "healthy eating" angle.  We had the chive soup and the lamb meatball sandwich, and they were both nice.  And like Quoc says in his review, the place has a wonderful view.  It was one of my favorite parts of the visit, and I'd love to see more of Edmonton / St. Albert with views like that.

But this isn't a five star review.  The Achille's Heel of this place lies in it's pricing, like the other reviewers have said.  While everything tasted nice, I don't feel it was "fine dining" enough for the price, and the quantity was on the small side as well.  You could argue that this is because it is meant to promote healthy portions - but then I'd argue that should be done for a lower price tag.

If you're in the area, and you prefer healthier eating, this is certainly an option for you, but it is over-priced for what it serves.

Had a wonderful meal tonight at Nellos in St Albert.  Quickly greeted at the door and shown to a table for two by the window! A lovely little restaurant and it was hopping! By the time we left at 8:30, not an empty table! In no time at all, our server Kathy greeted us and was not only pleasant but very efficient and knowledgeable! We had the bruschetta and muscles in wine sauce for appies and they were unbelievably good! And tons of food - like tons! Our main course was not as terrific  as the appetizers tho! I had Veal Marsala with spaghetti with gigi sauce and the spaghetti was fabulous but the veal was drowning in sauce but it was tasty enough.  Hubby had Veal Parm and the veal was very heavily breaded and very salty.  The meals were good but not as great as the appetizers.  But we saved room for desert and it was on par with the appies! Fabulous Creme Brulee - really fabulous! I'm not sure it we would go back as it is a bit of a drive for us (from Devon) but if we did I would order the muscles for sure but would stay away from the Veal dishes!  I would like to say the wait staff and the atmosphere were super!

I like how you can measure the prices per basic unit. It makes for excellent compariosn shopping, not to mention the lower prices for just about anything. They don't always have everything found at more expensive grocery stores; however, I can save $500/year minimum shopping there. Plus, home items and January sales are excellent. Add to the PC Points are fabulous way to save money, too.

I had been to this place now for the second time after my terrible experience with my poor havanese at local petsmart.
First impression - great little shop, with friendly and pleasant staff. Good to see them treat my dog nicely. 
I went for a full course grooming for my dog and he came out looking great. Don't expect bells and whistle that doesn't matter really in the actual site! The place gives a small town shop feel, which has not yet caught in the 'plastic' commercial courtesy of most city shops. 
The menu of service is well listed and the price reasonable anything slightly more - I would have stated expensive. 
Remember to book in advance as these folks are quite busy and book minimum 3 to 4 weeks in advance.

Hoping to see continuing good customer service and the wonderful grooming they do to my dog.

Believe me, I am not giving 5 stars - so you don't raise your expectation to unreasonable level and feel let down - which can only happen if you have unrealistic expectation.
If you are looking for a good pet grooming place, you definitely got to try these folks.

TIP: It is good to note that they are on Gervais Rd and Gloucester Dr. as Tudor Glen Place is not found on my GPS.

My mother and I went for groceries the other day, everything went fine until we got to the checkout. There was a till, the lift was on, there was no sign up, we had assumed the cashier had just gone over to ask a quick question to one of their supervisors. But nope. We stood there for a few minutes, waiting patiently, looking over at the THREE cashier/supervisor/customer service reps who were talking amongst themselves and staring back at us. I finally had to walk over, break up their conversation to ask them if any one of them was working the till that was clearly open. They said no, said 'mmm she should be there' and I said 'well she's not' and walked back to my mom and then finally a girl came up. I work in a grocery store too, and this shit would not fly. Bad customer service at the checkout, very disappointed and embarrassed for the owner for sure.

Enjoyed a really great meal at this unassuming little spot. The combo of excellent food, ridiculous portions and stellar service (shout out to Kimmy!) made for the perfect storm of Italian goodness. I started with the broccoli salad, which was nicely cooked and beautifully seasoned -- a nice light start before the pasta onslaught of Puttanesca. As with the salad, the pasta was cooked well, super-tasty, and the portion was enough for two. That being said, I made it through 3/4 before throwing in the towel. 

My dinner companion also gave two thumbs-up for her Caesar salad, and for her Shrimp and Scallops main. Coming from Vancouver (aka the city of seafood snobs), we were mildly apprehensive about seafood in St. Albert, but the quality was outstanding. Wish we'd tried the fresh mussels that were on special. Next time!

I'll definitely be back whenever I return to St. Albert.

When I got to the door of this restaurant I was greeted by a couple of signs. One was a hand written note saying, "If you're in a hurry, you're in the wrong place." The other said no hats or muscle shirts. Well, considering the adverse reactions I've been having to my temporarily pink hair, I was wearing a hat. I contemplated whether to leave or just suck it up and walk in there with the pink hair and decided the latter.

It isn't especially clear whether you're supposed to seat yourself or wait - there are no signs about that. I waited and was escorted to the bar since I was alone. They had an impressive wine list including port wines anywhere from 10 to 40 years! 

I was craving angel hair pasta and their cream sauce was good - it tasted like mushrooms a bit though I didn't see any. I decided to try a cappuccino for dessert. Trust me, anywhere that offers a cappuccino, I'm going to try it. Though it wasn't the best I've tasted, it wasn't horrible either. The poor waitress burned her hand making it. It was served in a Ferrari cup which sort of seemed childish in a way. 

This isn't the place to go if you're looking for cheap eats, either. For my pasta, a beer and a cappuccino my bill came to about $30!

It took me way too long, but I finally made it to Nello's.  From what I understand, the current owner is the original owner's son... What's better than a family run restaurant!?

I made some last minute reservations on a Friday for dinner.  Boy does this place ever fill up quickly.  It was maybe half full when we arrived, but within 15 minutes, every single table was occupied.

Our server was great.  Very attentive without being overbearing.

At first glance, the prices may seem high.  But don't be fooled.  You are getting a MOUNTAIN of food for that.

Our table of 4 ordered two of the Lobster Taglietelle, 1 Pollo Parmigiana, and 1 Pollo Alla Panna and nobody was disappointed.  The Lobster dish came with beautifully cooked lobster tail and huge prawns and scallops.  Everyone had leftovers to take home and enjoy over the weekend.

It's a quaint little place, and I definitely suggest making a reservation after seeing how fast they fill up!

Summary:
- gem in St Albert
- beautiful room with an amazing view of Lois Hole Centennial Provincial Park
- great food, good service and priced appropriately for what the fine dining experience they are delivering

Detailed review:
The Prairie Bistro in located in the beautiful, new Enjoy Centre in St Albert. The first thing that struck me as I was led into the dining room was the floor-to-ceiling windows that looked west towards Lois Hole Centennial Provincial Park - it's all green and lots of water. The place did not feel like Edmonton/St Albert; instead I felt like I was in a resto on the coasts of somewhere like BC, Washington St or Oregon. 

Menu had a good selection of dishes (salads, soups, apps, entrees, desserts) but was simple. I gravitated to the charcuterie plate which was an assortment of in-house cured meats served with a pickled vegetable medley - don't be deterred by this higher priced appy as there are 5 different meats and the veggies were a perfect accompaniment. For my entree, I went with the night's special - a perfectly cooked duck breast (crispy on the outside and rare on the inside) also served with a nice selection of summer veggies. My dinner mate had the cheese plate as his app (which had similar selection as my plate) as well as the steak tartare app for his entree - he enjoyed both very much. We didn't opt for dessert as we had alternate plans.

I also enjoyed how they had the drink menu inside a vintage Maclean's magazine - a simple but unique/nice touch. I didn't take a hard look at the wine list so don't have too much to say about that (will report more next time). I thought our server did a good job at topping up our water/wine on a regular basis without smothering us - this was important as my dinner mate and I were having great conversation! Overall, very pleased with the service.

Something else to note is there is a casual dining area adjacent to the restaurant. I believe you go up to a counter and order off a smaller menu for take out. 

Definitely worth the drive up to St Albert to try - will be returning!!

Very simply one of the best pasta places in the city.  To start off with the atmosphere is wonderful. The wine selection is great and the service was excellent. 

The lobster pasta is to die for!

Simply delicious!!  I had veal parmigiana and it was to die for.  The veal was prepared perfectly, the cheese the herb/spices were not overwhelming, and there was so much spaghetti on the side I couldn't eat it all.  I had the meat sauce that was quite tasty.  My husband had stuffed red peppers, he says they were amazing.  Soft, not mushy, says they tasted fantastic.  He had a beer and I had some pop and the bill with a tip was like $87.

Awesome food, too much food to be honest, at a great price.

The manager here is a BIG asshole, treated me horribly when I tried to deal with an item recall. He talked down to me in front of other customers and employees and he treated one of his employees poorly right in front of me. She was actually trying to help me out with the situation. Anyway I haven't had any other issues here, but makes me angered enough to not go here anymore.
It's right by my work so I come here all the time. Staff here is great, good service. Lunch time extremely busy though with a school nearby!

We went to Nello's for the first time last week and invited friends to accompany us. It was a good experience in every way, excellent menu choices, very tasty and excellent service. We felt it was reasonably priced for the quality. We will definitely go back!

For some odd reason I had never been before until about two months ago and now I've been back twice. Lunch portions and price were good. Service was ok. The chicken rice soup is almost a meal in itself.

I needed to use my Teambuy coupon so I decided to take my boys on a whim. Best part was we walked in just after 5pm on a Saturday and didn't have to wait for a table. We were done our meal and home just over an hour later. Food was really good, service was quick and staff friendly.

We went to Nello's for my 25th birthday, after reading the reviews good and bad I thought I'd give it the benefit of the doubt. To my dismay it was just terrible. From the minute we walked in the atmosphere was incredibly pretentious. Nello ,the owner, sat and the bar and glared at us. The food was ridiculously overpriced and incredibly bland. For the price you would expect the pasta to be homemade, it was from safeway. The average spaghetti meal there was a whopping 26.99, for good food, ok maybe I'd pay, but for safeway brand pasta and jarred sauce; I don't think so. I highly recommend staying far away from this establishment. If you're rich and incredibly dumb with no tastebuds you might enjoy it.
So be warned.
Kim

Probably my favourite location in St. Albert... which sucks for me, because it's the furthest away from me hahaha.. just my luck.

The staff are friendly and they never seem to be out of stuff.  Well, at least not the things that I want.

Service is fast and efficient and orders are always correct.  What else can you want?

No BS, quick and efficient drive through service. Perfect for North American cars and up to mid-end Asian imports. Waaay better than going to GM, Chrysler and Ford dealerships for routine service. Just no crazy s**t like BMW, Mercedes and the like, though Lexus and Acura are welcome; though I wouldn't take a car costing over $60k to them, considering the car price usually indicates a degree of complexity that I think they might not be equipped to handle, unless the car is several years old.

Best small spot in town. Owner is super hands on and talks to every table. We were there and it was very busy, due to a 5 min wait for or reserved table the owner bought everyone a drink and a desert. The pasta was amazing, really impressed with everything. Great date spot in town.

We had a wonderful night. We started with some mussels and a bottle of wine before we opened up the menus. The ambiance is wonderful for an intimate evening with friends. I had the pastichio which was an incredible plate of competing flavours. 5 different pasta's smothered in a rich creamy sauce. Everyone enjoyed their meal. We all had the creme brûlée for dessert. Oh what a great place to share with good friends. I would recommend this as one of my top 3 Italian restaurants. We are definitely going back!

I asked a tall dark haired young man in the meat dept. if he would re-wrap the roast of meat I wanted as it was bloody on both ends when he finally came back with the roast I had chose & quickly disappeared again that same piece of meat was  now almost $2.00 more what the any way I was then mad & just put it back & left with half the things I was going to buy because with out the meat I didn't need the rest so that young man cost the store an extra $40-$50.00

I've been at Nello's many many times, for every occasions such as Xmas party, wedding anniversary, b'days or just plain for supper with my wife. If you are in the mood for Italian food this is the place. Don't think you can just walk in & out in a matter of 30 to 45 mins because this is not the place. It is more of a relax place. The restaurant is not very big but they will accomodate large parties but call way a head of time. If you decide to be a walk in, get there before 6pm because it will get busy very fast after 6pm. The price for the food is a little on the above average but you get a lot on your plate for the price. The menu is not big but the portions are big. Everything is freshly made and everyone working there is very friendly. They are open for lunch with a smaller menu. I'm not a wine drinker but I was told by my friends that the wine menu is pretty good and they also have a full bar. After going there a few times, the staff (servers) remembered us and came over to greet us, very nice...

I'm not one for Italian food but it was my sisters birthday and she wanted this place. Super friendly service! The food was the best (coming from someone whose choice for Italian would be dead last). Noodles and cheese just isn't appealing for me but I was super surprised and so thankful i came. Soooo delicious!!

It's pricey but if you're paying for quality and service, they're being ripped off. This place is one of new favs!

Best Italian restaurant in Edmonton and area.  Pasta is always cooked to the right consistency and flavours are consistent and very good.  Prices are higher but portions are generous, so works out to be slightly above average.  
Apps - really good Caesar salad.  Calamari is crispy and fresh tomato sauce, not a fan of the "tartar" sauce.
Food - lobster tagliatelle is my favourite dish, good portion and very tasty.  Veal Marsala is very tasty but nor very filling.
Atmosphere - average.  Not too lively but not stuffy.  
Wine list - average for Edmonton.

I used to love going there. It was easy to find what you wanted but then they changed the place. Made it more like at Wal-Mart, shortened up the rows and removed some product so they could put more deals at the end of the rows. I can't find anything now. That's why I removed one star. If you're searching for a great service you better go at Safeway, if you're searching for choices and things you can't find at other places go to Save-On (I find they're the most expensive), but if you want the cheapest price this one is in the top to get good prices. It's clean, you still have good choices, prices are good, there's a pharmacy in it, toilets and any things you need for the house you'll pretty much find it there. I recommend this place for doing your grocery even after the changes.

You will be taking home half of your dinner for sure.   Overall, good fresh food with a casual environment. 

I was a fan of the pasta and the delicious sauces.  The staff was friendly and caring which always helps.  I felt that the prices were a little over the top. I would probably not go back, due to the high prices.

Really good food! Portions are huge and service is great! Very friendly staff. Really enjoyed date night here! Have recommended this place to a few couples I know! Will keep recommending! Keep up the good work!

Our bichons are 8 and 3 and we've been bringing our dogs here for over 5 years. The staff at Clippin' Along are totally incredible! They're professional, friendly and always do a fantastic job! Our dogs actually get excited to go there and when we pick them up, our dogs act like they've just had a day at the spa! 
Thank you to all of the staff at Clippin' Along! You are amazing!

I love taking my dogs here. The staff are so friendly and great with my dogs. They actually get excited to get hair cuts now! I have two Pomeranians and I'm picky with how they get their hair cut but the Clippin Along staff do a great scissor cut and give them the round fluffy look I like.
Loved their pasta dishes!! Wait staff were really friendly as well! I'd definitely recommend them and go again!

Now that I have been going for close over a year, need to revisit my review and update. 
They still do a good job and make me comfortable by the way they treat my dog. Still carry the small town business look and courteous staff. Definitely recommend. 
The price is very reasonable. Keep up the good work. This is a rare find.

I've come here twice now for dinner.

The restaurant is surprisingly cute and cozy for being in a strip mall - they do a great job of giving it an old Italian feel. 

Reservations are recommended here and dinner only - no lunch seatings.

I HIGHLY recommend the mussels (full or half order), traditional bruschetta, and the carbonara.  

If the sambuca prawns and scallops are on the menu for the day - JUST DO IT.  Cooked to perfection in the most heavenly sambuca cream sauce I have ever had.

My husband is in love with the rich, creamy, bacons carbonara and easily gets 2 meals out of it.

There are so many things I want to try but dang the mussels were so good I had them twice!  One time they had been overcooked a but but the other was divine.  The broth was so good I lapped it up as a soup with bread! 

Also this is gonna sound crazy but I had my first ever Caesar salad here.  I know, I know.  I've never been a creamy salad dressing person.  Anyhow, the waitress convinced me to try it and DAMN was it ever good - completely made in house.

We've tried the tiramisu and loved it!  And that's saying a lot because I'm pretty picky when it comes to Tiramisu! 

Also - the current owner/chef, Tony, is the son of the original owner.  Nice to see an authentic Italian business stay in the family.

Mmm... now I'm hungry!

Nello's is one of my all time favorites. I always make a reservation as it can get quite busy, especially on Friday and Saturday nights. 

The ceasar salad is amazing and the portions are generous. With large portions comes a large bill. I typically only go to Nello's when I have a Groupon.

 The staff are friendly and work very hard to keep up with the busy yet small resturant. Because of this, service can sometimes be slow but the quality of the food is well worth the wait. Kudos!

My husband and I bought a Groupon for Nello's as we had never heard of it before.  We were greeted by such a friendly girl it started our experience off great!  We started with the spicy bruschetta which was AMAZING - so amazing, we had to move the plate to the other side of the table so that we'd quit eating it! We then each ordered our own entree - I had the Putanesca and my husband ordered Veal Scaloppini - BOTH were incredible and the amount of food you get is crazy in the best way possible.  It makes the "higher prices" so very worth it.  My meal ended up being spread over four different meals for myself.  We finished the evening off with the tiramisu which was by far the best I have ever had - so light and full of flavor.  The only disappointment (and only reason I am not giving five stars) was the fact that when we asked for everything to be packed up, we were not given our bruschetta left overs - and there was quite a bit of that left so we basically just paid to try it. Other than that, what a great experience! We will definitely be back!

This is my favourite grocery store for many reasons. Superstore has been my number one choice for many years due to their lower prices, especially on name brand items, and some of the unique in-house selections. There are countless original President's Choice (their in-house brand) items of food products that aren't the just the trendy flavours some of their creations even help to set the trends. For example their President's Choice Deluxe white cheddar Mac and Cheese is, in my opinion, far superior to the fan favourite Kraft Mac and Cheese. The store seems to have about three prices for many of their food products that they cycle and knowing these cycles can greatly help getting the best deal. Many prices on some items are even as good or better than Costco on those items without the membership cost. They also have a lot more than groceries. While some of their clothing can be hit or miss in terms of quality overall you can't go wrong. I have a heavy terrycloth bathrobe that is still going strong after 14yrs of almost daily use. Not bad for a $15 clearance purchase lol. I actually like bringing my own bags as it cuts down on the crazy amount of plastic bags I had cluttering my home. I have also started using cashiers more to combat the disturbing trend of losing even more jobs to automation. So bring your own bags and start bargain hunting and maybe try a new crazy flavour of President's Choice frozen lasagna and PC Elk Crossing ice cream. You'll be glad you did.

While visiting with some friends of the family who live in St Albert, they took us to Nello's and claimed it was the best Italian restaurant in and around the Edmonton area. We weren't disappointed! All the food was very good and the portions were VERY generous. I can almost always finish what is in front of me and I had leftovers for the next day. The service was quite good; even though we were a large group, the food came out quickly. The waitress was very friendly too although she brought out the wrong wine. Other than that no problems! In fact the bartender found out we were celebrating an anniversary and brought out complimentary apple pie shots for the entire group of us and then even substituted for something else because of dietary restrictions. 

Would certainly go back and recommend Nello's to anyone looking for a nice Italian place. 4.5/5 overall.
the food is out of this world.   staff are super friendly and menu is  amazing.   really nice place for a family night out or a nice romantic date!   forsure will be back here

Incredible food!! full of rich quality ingredients. Authentic Italian eatery. I highly recommend for any hungry  pasta lovers. Huge portions. You will never leave hungry. The seafood pasta was full of prawns, lobster and scallops. In a rich creamy rose sauce. Excellently executed. Not over cooked or bland. Al dente !! My hats off to the chef!!

Every visit Lori and I make to Nello's brings back fond memories of visits to Toscano trattoria's many years ago. I think it's the blend of the wonderful smells of garlic, seafoods, and sauces mixed with sounds of wine glasses clinking, and the festive murmur of pleasant conversation from the dozen or so tables. The staff dart around the intimate dining room, filling glasses, delivering beautiful plates from the kitchen, and making intelligent wine and food recommendations. The casual feel of an authentic trattoria is captured, yet Nello's has stepped it up adding the higher level of service and selection Albertans want. Your servers will patiently walk you through everything if it's your first visit, or banter back and forth with you if you're a return fan. Other pluses: a really nice wine list for a budget or celebration night, a well thought out well priced menu, and some really good Grappa if you are brave enough for Italian moonshine, and have a designated driver! Alas that final star remains open for my only fussy Nello's thing: I'm hoping they can step up the espresso machine to serve a hot shot with adequate crema, But the tiramisu makes up for this small issue....

I absolutely love this StarBucks location! The workers are incredibly friendly- some of them even remember how I like my coffee. Is very clean, efficient and fresh. The main reason I keep returning here is for the amazing costumer service.

I popped into Superstore to pick up a bunch of Easter Egg dye kits on clearance for my toddler who's world crashed when Daddy used the last sparkly egg for scrambled eggs the other morning.  Unfortunately, my experience was unpleasant on this visit.

After waiting 10 minutes to speak to a supervisor and then eventually wandering around until I found one on the aisle of question, I am left disappointed that not only was I left waiting but they were also unable to resolve my concern.

I followed up with Scanning Code of Practice and Superstore Corporate Customer Service (Loblaws) as I felt I had been treated in an uncourteous manner and that not honouring posted prices/sales is unacceptable.

I will say that all of the cashiers and customer service staff I spoke with were both polite and professional. 

For followup, Corporate apologized and offered to mail me a gift card for the purchase.  In the meantime, I visited a different Superstore and had no issues with the clearance prices being honoured as advertised but it's silly that I had to travel in order to do so.  

I believe it is a valid concern that every customer before me was charged the wrong price and even after I brought it to their attention, rather than apologizing and making the situation right - the immediate response  went into defence mode and remained that way.

I do appreciate the Corporate Customer Service department and their follow up with me regarding the situation.  I was impressed that they were both easily accessible and expedient at response time.

I still love so many things about Superstore including their awesome PC brands, friendly chap in the lotto booth, and overall store... but am left feeling sad about this interaction.  I hope that my opinion will be raised again in the future.

Good food - BUT - way too much. Pasta was good, but the breaded veal was as thick as an average steak, not the thinner veal normally associated with a veal parmigiano dish. Good ceasar salad, nicely warmed fresh bread basket. Service was good. Well priced for quantity, overpriced for quality.
Excellent food! No other Italian restaurant compares! Great service and very friendly, absolutely love this place!

I come here often because its right on my way to work, but some mornings it's a headache. About 1/2 the time they seem to get my order wrong or mixed up with someone else's and there's one woman who works here that I swear just hates her job!
Best experience for an oil change. I didn't feel uncomfortable or stupid asking questions and my technician gave me honest answers. I think I'll dread oil changes a little less now. Thanks!

Don't waste your time or your money. The food is way overpriced and the service is absolutely terrible! I had the lamb meat ball on a ciabatta  for a hefty $18.00!!! We waited close to an hour to get our sandwiches and couldn't get refills on our water! (The server claimed she couldn't find any water containers for our table!) The ciabatta bun was served so incredibly 'wet' from who knows what that I had to leave the bottom half of the soaked bun on the plate. Nothing special about the lamb meatball which was almost flavorless and oh so tiny!  The server never came by to see how the food was ... as a matter of fact it was almost impossible to get her attention for the entire 2 1/2 hours we sat there. I would definitely choose anywhere else to eat from now on and vow never to return to this place for lunch or dinner!

Well as someone who works days, and did not grow up in Alberta, I appreciate and use Yelp as an actual resource for finding and accessing services.  Clippin' Along advertises as accepting walk in pet grooming appts, and I've shown up again to find them closed earlier than on this site and on their business sign......very disappointing when you consider the effort of rushing home and packing up my animal and they're not open when advertised... it's out of my way, from the city....

This place is soooo nice!The people are so nice and there is all the things you need!Theres books and toys and candy and some more candy and even more then that!Mostly if you like coffee then you should go to Starbucks or especially chapters.

This continues to be our go-to grocery store.

While I haven't forgotten the unfortunate mis-priced incident or the way it was handled (including a Superstore employee writing threatening comments to me on Yelp) I do recognize that was just one person and not reflective of the company as a whole.

I've really loved how the Joe Fresh line has continued to evolve here and the clothing has become a staple in our household.

We will continue to be regulars for the amazing PC Green Brand Cat Litter as well as produce and Harvest Grains Protein Bread.

I also like that the points card is available through my smartphone as an app - way handier than a physical card.

See you soon Superstore... like every single week ;-)

Nell's has quickly become my favourite Italian eatery.

Every single time I have to order the Carbonara because it's simply the best.  The portions here are huge and can easily feed the army of a small country.

I've also enjoyed the bruschetta and the housemade caesar salad which might be the best one I have ever had.

The Mrs. usually orders something seafood related and raves about the Samba Scallops and Prawn dish.

The tiramisu here is outstanding and puts the Olive Garden to shame.

See you soon, Nello's.

P.S. Ask for Cathie - great server!

I highly recommend Nello's restaurant! The food was fantastic and the portions were huge. The service was second to none. We had the mussels, caesar salad, chicken arrabbiata, lobster tagliatelle and tiramisu. I have to say, this is our new favourite  restaurant

Four of us for supper Oct 2017 and then second visit Jan 2019.

Good food, great service and a nice atmosphere. The place was packed as it usually is Fridays and Sat and the other days reservations are still recommend. It is a small room with a lot of people so it  was quite  loud and overly  warm. We were having so much fun we were probably part of the noise makers. Not the perfect spot for a quiet romantic dinner for two but great for those days when a livelier atmosphere fits better. 

Calamari, couple of salads for appys,  chicken parm, veal Marsala with Penne and spicy tomato sauce, one gnocchi and one order of gluten free pasta. Food was very good. Pasta cooked perfect and the various meats were spot on. One Creme Brule for dessert. All the portions were very large and most had leftovers.  

Total bill for 4, $200 with no alcohol. Not cheap but about on par for St Albert  where most restaurant prices are pretty high due to the outrageous taxes and other costs to operate there.

Service was attentive and always there  when needed but never intrusive. Great job of serving while being almost invisible. 

Would definitely go back.

I've been to many branches of this chain and can count on them for good prices on most groceries, plus a wide variety of household goods, beauty products, drugstore items, inexpensive clothing (great for babies and toddlers in particular) - pretty much anything you want in one-stop convenience.  There are some sites I would not return to, such as Clareview, but the St Albert location is always clean, well-stocked and tidy.   Checkout here is much quicker and more efficient, as opposed to some other sites where it becomes a tedious chore, so I don't mind popping in for a few things or for a full shopping list.  Bring your eco-bags if you don't want to pay for plastic - it's good to see that most customers there come prepared.

It's also handy that PC Bank has an ATM inside as well as staff to help you open a free account or sort out problems.

STAY AWAY! They are very disorganized, ignore customers existive, and give terrible service. I took my car in for a routine oil and filter change. They told me everything was great and everything went well. I got home and noticed my car was leaking a lot of oil. So I called them back they told me no problem they will fix it for free. I had to go back there a total of three times because my car was still leaking! The last time I went they told me that if it is still leaking oil, that they will pay for the damage that they have done when I go to a mechanic. Came back with a bill of $250 in damage that they did because they tried to use silicon to stop the leak! Then told me that they will not pay for the damage! These people don't know what they are doing! Don't trust them with your car!
Very friendly staff! the experience was pretty good. my boyfriend and i had never tried it before and we were both please minus the creme brûlée.

The worst location I've ever been to! Out of the 5 people there, not a single person acknowledged my presence. Between that and the blaring music and dirty floors I thought maybe they were closed, and I was completely ignored until the cups were stacked (the customer is obviously not a priority here) After standing at the counter a few minutes I finally get to order. For some reason it took twice as long to make it than it usually does...and it tasted like crap. (I was the only customer besides one guy who was also waiting for his order.) I've gotten the same coffee for 10 years at Starbucks so I know when it's not right. I asked for another one and i waited another 10mins for it. They got it right the second time but I was floored that this was an actual Starbucks as I have never received such crappy service and have never seen one so dirty. I will never go back to that location..do better St. Albert.

I have been many times and beee happy with mmm experience. This last time I was a bit disappointed. The service was friendly. The decor is cutsie. The portions are hhuge. But the  quality this last time was lacking. The lettuce in my salad  was browned. My lobster was a bit tough. Yes I know it's not a seafood restaurant. But they've done better in the past.

This is one of my family's favourite places for dinner. They're always very accommodating and the staff is very knowledgable and professional. The food is authentic and delicious with quite the variety. I love when we get to treat ourselves to Nello's as it's a family-owned business and worth every penny spent!

So so SO happy this location has reopened for drive thru during the pandemic. 

The staff here are fabulous and David is a social media whiz keeping everyone up to date with their hours and what was going on when they were closed. 

2 thumbs way up!

Having to work during the pandemic is stressful but being able to enjoy a treat like a matcha green tea latte makes the day a little easier.  

Mar props to David for keeping the community in the loop and for constantly doing updates like how we can do ride up on our bikes and do mobile orders for those of us trying to find ways to treat our kidlets who miss normal.  For now, Starbucks bicycle Frappuccino dates are a great way to celebrate special days like birthdays!!! 

Thank you Starbucks
We had a great meal here before Covid-19 in February. We haven't been going out lately but I can't wait to go here again.

I don't like to run anyone down...especially Nellos where we used to eat on a very regular basis. But come on Nellos...you can do better!
Four of us ate last night and not one of us enjoyed our meals. Food had the flavour of a fast food joint in the mall, chicken portions were tiny, Puttanesca had maybe one ounce of meat maximum and half of that was a piece of fat. You can do better Nellos...maybe get Rosa back in the kitchen!
Best Frappuccino I've been served in a long time.  Not diluted, all toppings added.  The guy at the drive through window was also very nice as we waited a little for my drink to be made.

Hubs and I have been coming to Nello's regularly going on 4 years now. 

The food is consistent, the portions are large, and we always leave with happy tummies. 

Recently we decided to go and order ONLY new to us items as we tend to stick to mussels, bruschetta, carbonara, and prawns and scallops in a sambouca cream sauce. 

I'll admit we were nervous to venture from our tried and true favourites but ended up oh so happy that we did! 

My new favourite here is the chilled broccoli salad!  Yep, you read that right!  Blanched broccoli immediately chilled in an ice bath and then tossed with olive oil, fresh garlic, and a little salt and pepper served with a lemon wedge.  Our server suggested we also try sprinkling a little parm on top.  Oh. Em. Gee.  Hubs and I were seriously considering ordering a second salad.  The crispness of the broccoli, the intensity of the fresh garlic, everything was just heaven!  The lemon you squeeze atop yourself really brought the salad to life! 

The Apollo Alla Panna was cooked to perfection - juicy chicken breast smothered in a cream sauce with broccoli and mushrooms.  The dish had an almost smoky taste or quality from the hot pan.  It was delish.  As a side, we also chose Caesar salad which is to DIE for here. 

Hubs and I passed on the bread and dessert for this date night as we're about 4 months into maintaining a new lifestyle with lower carbs and higher protein.  It was wonderful to see that we can still thoroughly enjoy a meal at one of our our favourite Italian restaurants without detailing from our lifestyle goals. 

One more thing, Nello's has different specials each day of the week: Monday BYO Wine, no corkage fee, Tuesday 1/2 price wine, wine Wednesday $1/oz, Sunday's kids eat free, etc.

This place has been a favorite of mine for years. Always delicious. Lately I've had four people from out of town come in for business. Audrey is an excellent server! She knows how to interact with guests suited to the reason you are there. She (they) are very accommodating!

I am a rookie dog owner, up to last summer the only pets I ever owned were fish. I took the big plunge last year and adopted a wonderful standard poodle puppy.  Now was the time to start learning the in's and out's of poodle care.

I asked a few friends where they took their dogs in St. Albert and only good things were said about Clippin'Along. I check yelp and read a good review here. So booked Mac in and we were set. 

The cut was great, they treated Mac so well he didn't want to leave. We have been back twice since then, Mac gets really excited when he realizes where he is going. I really can't say enough good!

We enjoyed a lovely meal at Nellos in St.Albert.
4 yelp.
Food. Gnocchi 5 yelp, chicken parmigiana with penne (or your choice of pasta) 5 yelp.

Atmosphere 4 yelp
Good value  we'll try the downtown location next time.

First of all, let me just put it out there that I love Starbucks!  I'm originally form Seattle, Washington & a Starbucks girl at heart!

I've been coming to this location for almost a year now and have probably come a good 20 times.

It's a convenient location in Village Landing in the same parking lot as Save On Foods and Shoppers Drug Mart.

Their drive through is efficient and friendly.  The inside of the store is smaller than most Starbucks and for that reason they only get 4 stars.  Sometimes it can be tough to get a seat and it doesn't feel as  cozy and inviting as some of my fave locations.

The staff are super friendly and cheerful even early in the morning!

My heart belongs to Starbucks...

If I could give zero stars, I would. 

I have used their click and collect service for over five months and other than them forgetting some of my groceries more times than not, I stuck with it. I enjoy being able to control the amount I spend as I am on a tight budget. This week they double withdrew from my account. When I contacted them about it, they advised it could take up to seven days for a refund, so not only can they not tell me why this time it was different but they claim they can't get me a refund any sooner. Apparently when you make millions you don't realize the customers don't have extra money to be taken from their account and then wait around for a refund for a week. I'm still waiting.......

Dear St Albert Superstore,
 I have been shopping at your store since it opened. I was originally attracted by the reasonable and in some cases low prices .In the last 4 or 5 years  I have been impressed, maybe the better word is awed, by the kindness, generosity and knowledge of the staff at the St. Albert store. The cashiers like Rose ,Lisa and Cathy have all been very helpful whenever I have been there.
The bakery crew of Melinda, Keri, a small Chinese woman and two Moslem women have been extremely generous with their time and advice.
Please convey my sincere gratitude to all the individuals mentioned and to all other staff members who make shopping there a uniquely positive event.
Sincerely,
Dr David G. Wangler

They have the rudest most disrespectful staff I have ever met. They constantly refer to me as an old bag and refuse to take my order. We don't take orders from old women and don't come back. The manager always seems to have her dirty mucky boots on the seat. She constantly disrespects the customers and the furniture. This nazi woman should be fired.

I'm so impressed with anyone who works the drive-in window at any Starbucks - how in the heck do they hear people rattle off complicated personalized orders and manage to repeat it all back correctly?   It's the verbal equivalent of speed reading!!

Yay for choices, for flavours, for caffeine or decaf, for frappes, for EVERYTHING!  And double yays for two-for-one times!!

It wasn't until I moved to St. Albert that I started shopping at Superstore. Not that I am snotty (reputations be damned) I just recently had my kids begin to eat more food as they grow past their toddler stage. 

My impression is but what you can at Costco and supplement the additional products here. The clothes are great, the selection for house/home is decent but overpriced and the seasonal is best when buying after the fact for next year. 

If I were to write about the Pharmacy however I may teach people a few new swear words....go somewhere else as a rule with Superstore and you will likely be better off. The service or system is broken here with and I just admit defeat and go to Safeway as we have two coverage plans. The service is better and the drugs probably are too .... I don't need to lose my freaking mind over my liver no name pills that eventually get recalled.

Yum! This place was great! We came here on Monday for a belated Mother's Day dinner! It was good! It was really pretty and clean inside which is always a plus, and on Monday's it doesn't seem too busy. I would say check this place out on a weekday.

We ordered the lamb appetizer to start! It was kind of like a tiny meal in itself. There were 4 lamb pieces and a bit of beans, potatoes and broccoli! All very very delicious! We shared it between 4 people and it was good! They gave us a loaf of bread and butter as well.

I wasn't feeling like pasta that day so I decided on bocconcini salad with a side of chicken breast! I'm kind of weird in the way that I don't like tomato salad but I love bocconcini salad for some reason! Thankfully this was a great salad! I love crisp tomatoes! I hate when tomatoes are soggy and gross but this salad was cold with really crispy veggies and it was yummy. I really liked my salad!

My boyfriend and his mom got pasta which they enjoyed! Huge portions! And my boyfriends dad got the meatballs which he said were good!

For desert we had the tiramisu! It's not the best I've ever had but it was still decent! The creme brule was also yummy!

It was kind of weird at the end because the server just deposited the check at the end but didn't ask if we wanted coffee or anything! My in-laws love coffee so that was kind of a tiny disappointment. But overall it was a really great dinner! I enjoyed it a lot!
Absolute garbage service! And super shady! Manager won't even talk with you he plays telephone with his staff.

Finally made it here on a business dinner a few weeks back after living in St. Albert for nine years. It won't take me that long to make my way back.

A really nice little Italian restaurant in an unassuming strip mall on St. Albert Trail, it doesn't look like much from the outside. But inside it is a cozy little spot with exceptional service.

To be honest I wan't overwhelmed with my entree'. I opted for the Beef Tenderloin as I was intrigued that it was sauteed in cognac and olive oil. There were four of us dining, two of us ordered the Beef Tenderloin and the other two ordered the Rack of Lamb. Both of us ordering the Beef Tenderloin ordered ours medium and both of us received them well done. Still tasty, but definitely overdone. The guys that chose this spot RAVED about the Caesar salad here but I found it very average and that it had way too much dressing. The roasted potatoes this was served with were exceptional however.

What will bring me back here is the appetizers and wine (as well as the service). We ordered three pounds of mussels to start... first off let me say that I love mussels. And these were literally the best I have ever had that weren't ocean side. Served in a delicious tomato sauce these were simply amazing. We had a house red wine as well (I am no wine connoisseur so couldn't tell you anything other than it was fantastic and alot of it was consumed that evening). The bruschetta was good as well, but damn those mussels are what will bring me back. Can't wait for a date night with Heather where we will stick to mussels and wine!

We went to the restaurant Monday night!  It was a great meal.  We will definitely go again.   Cozy but nice, the service was great and relaxed.   I had the veal parmigiana and my daughter had the chicken parmigiana. Great portions!  Left overs for the next night....lol

The only thing I must say is the desserts are overpriced for what you get.   $10 for a small not very flavorful piece of Tiramasu.

Had a show in my lovable home town of St. Albert and just for kicks checked on trip advisor for the best resto's listed and #2 was Nello's. Wasn't totally in the mood for Italian, but ok let's go.

When you walk in this place it looks very cozy, family like indeed. We were quickly seated and got some cocktails to start. Just sitting there looking around at the all the other people there I immediately felt somehow comfortable. There were kids (which I generally despise) old couples, young couples and everyone just seemed so happy.

Got some calamari to start. Now the thing they don't tell you when you walk in to Nello's is that the portions are huuuuge! So a 4 pound platter of deep fried squidy goodness shows up and omg sooo good. Came with their homemade marinara sauce which was absolutely gorgeous. All fresh with huge chunks of tomato and basil.

Main course baby. My gf ordered a pasta dish that had (not joking) 5 different pastas with enough cheese to block up the entire Eskimo's roster not to mention the two sauces that covered this concoction. By the time she finished it didn't even look like she had made a dent. Good Ukranian lass that she is she packed it all up and now has lunches for a week. 

I ordered the meatballs, of which I am a sucker for. 3 baseball sized balls show up covered in marinara and parmigiana with like a pound of gluten free pasta. The meatballs were so tender and flavourful, usually meatballs that size are all dried out in the middle and crumble into meat dust. I didn't really need the pasta and later found out the meatball are 3 bucks a piece and can be ordered individually. Kinda wish the waitress would have mentioned that earlier but I'll b ok. Oh btw you get an entire loaf of bread as you sit down. 

This place is a belts worst nightmare. The entire meal with drinks cost me 100 bucks so your wallet will lose a little weight but nothing crazy. Especially when you consider the portions are crazy large. If you make it out to the burb of St Albert stop by(don't let the sign turn you off it is horrible) You will leave satisfied I assure you. And you even get to listen to super cheesy Italian pop covers of tunes from 1993. Sounds bad, but guess the song is kinda fun. 

Thanks Nello's

Cheers

Andy

Expensive for Italian but absolutely predictable, consistent , decent homestyle Italian food and very friendly service. The food is genuine Italian and the owner is too. If you are rude and unfriendly he might kick you out. The signs on the front door remind you not to wear your hat and basically send the message that no bums are welcome. Clean bathrooms too!!

The lamb entree was good. Fettucine Alfredo and the jumbo shrimp in garlic and butter were both over cooked. 

Also ordered it through skip  to hotel room and they included no cutlery or napkins yay! 

The good thing was you could sort of use the lamb bones as cutlery, but not really.

Typical neighbor hood style Pub located in a strip mall. Lots of parking, plenty of TVs, busy during big games, mostly an older crowd with what look like a lot of regulars. There is one guy that looks like he nearly lives there. He has been there every time I have been in the pub, has a brief case full of papers and books and sits at the same table. Kind of reminds me of the old TV show Cheers.

Staff are friendly and pretty quick though often they seem a little understaffed for the number of clients. Food is average to good pub type menu. It would be pretty easy to bring the food up a few notches and make this place really stand out.

Good place for a beer and watch the game with a little food thrown in. Appetizers are well presented and done, mains are a little more pedestrian but plenty edible, just don't expect to be wowed, they aren't going to be showing up on Diners, Drive Ins and Dives any time soon.
Great little place. Never too busy. Service is awesome and food is reasonably prices and always good. The pizza is amazing

The roast pork, scalloped potatoes and salad were very good.  Ample portions.
Great value.
Excellent service.
I definitely will be back.

Nice pub Troy!

Nice guys - good service and they will even pick up your lawnmower for you to sharpen and drop it back off at your house!  

They do mechanical fixings, motors, sharpening of skates, etc.

Free estimates :-)
THE store to buy a book, toys, stationary, browsing.  Staff is ever so helpful. Its THE best of the best.  Have ordered books, prepaid and had them sent to my home.

My siblings and I go out for dinner together for Christmas rather than buying one another gifts.  This year we chose Ric's in St. Albert.  I think the average 3 star rating is pretty appropriate.  Decent looking restaurant, standard food, good wine list, solid service and on this Thursday night they played live jazz.

I can't remember what I had as far as the steak goes but I know that my sister ordered the same thing and when mine came out they had forgotten my whiskey sauce and some of my vegetables.  They fixed the problem quickly but I was shocked that you have two of the same orders and one comes out wrong.

The other challenging thing was that with such a high ceiling this is a difficult restaurant to keep at a good temperature.  We almost had to wear our jackets and when the door opened you would feel the rush of cold air come in.  We weren't even near the door but still felt the affects.

The food was pretty standard for a steak house but I think there are other locations I'll visit in the future.

I wanted to have lunch and since Ric's Grill is located at the one of the entrance points to the farmers' market, it was an obvious choice. The atmosphere is very classy and relaxed, and all of the servers seemed very friendly. The menu has a variety of burgers, steak/ribs, and salads. Prices are on the higher end, but also seem reasonable. 

I had a vegetable burger, which at around $14 was on the lower end of the price scale. It was one of the most unique veggie burgers I have ever had, from the rice/bean/mushroom-based patty to the avocado slices on top. I decided to deviate from fries and opted for a side order of the spinach salad. Also unique, the delicate leaves were adorned with a poppyseed dressed and slices of almond, and also had beets in it. Delicious, and refreshing.

If I came here for a supper I would definitely try a steak or another meat dish. It appears that Ric's Grill has some original ideas.

I do not do a review until we have tried a place many times. It's been about 3 months and a dozen breakfasts, so now is the time.

It's hard to find a consistently good breakfast place. A couple of years ago our favorite place closed down. We have been on the hunt ever since. And now we've found it!

Campbell's fills the bill. Meals are always hot, eggs are done to perfection every time and the home shredded potatoes are a dream. Service from either of the two great morning girls is impeccable. Prices are very reasonable especially the morning special.
It is our new favorite breakfast hang out.

Our favourite pub in St. Albert. The staff are friendly and excellent. The food is great pub food and always delivers. The daily drink and food specials are always excellent. A great place to watch the game, or catch the bus to the eskimos or oilers game. An eclectic mix of people with your locals and seniors during the day giving way to a younger crowd in the evening.

Our go to breakfast restaurant. The morning potatoes are freshly shredded in house and lightly pan fried, not those heavy, greasy deep fried ones that most places serve. I'm very particular about my eggs and they have never let me down. The food is always piping hot. Excellent breakfast special until 11 weekdays and 2 on the weekends. A little hard to find, but it's across the street and a couple of blocks west of the casino east of Campbell road.

Awesome food, personal, prompt, and caring service, first class venue, and entertainment included, what a fantastic place, what a great time!  
We celebrated our 24th wedding anniversary at the Apex Casino in the Vee dining room in a private room that they call "The Vault", I'm not sure that words can do justice to the amazing time we had, you really need to experience it for yourself!
There were eight of us for dinner, we were ushered into The Vault, where we found a large dining table formally set in black linen with red and white accents, correctly placed silverware and glassware (sadly a novelty these days), and centerpieces.  Our meal options were chosen from a specially prepared personalized menu which had been printed for us and included a personal message and picture of us on it.  The four course meal was absolutely delectable and included hot hors d'oeuvres followed by soup or salad, a selection of three from the menu, after which came your choice of entree, we had a choice of steak and prawns, salmon fillet in cream sauce, or chicken breast served with melted brie and cranberry wine sauce, and finally dessert, Red Velvet cheese cake, Chocolate Almond Torte, or deep dish apple pie a la monde. Despite a concerted effort, no one was able to finish all their food.

I can't rave enough about the treatment received from the management and wait staff.  It was like dining at a five star resort.  Between the personal attention from Rameez, the dining room manager and the conscientious, prompt, and efficient service from our dedicated server, Roxanne who managed to always be available to refresh drinks, refill coffee, and attend to our wants without being perceived as hovering or intruding.  In a word the service and the treatment we received was "Outstanding".  The staff was so nice we almost felt like inviting them to sit and enjoy the dinner too!  

For our entertainment a Blackjack table was set up in the room, we were provided with "Play Money" and a professional dealer, from the casino's staff.  Our play money was personalized with our name and a picture from our wedding day on it - such a nice touch.  Our dealer, Terrance, was knowledgeable, entertaining, and amusing,  He was especially patient and took the time to explain the nuances of the game to us non-gamblers.

This event will go down in our family annals as possibly the best anniversary celebration ever, the bar has been raised!  The casino and dining room staff made our experience very special and we certainly will be doing this again!  We recommend the Apex Casino and Vee Dining Room, to anyone looking to host a smaller private dinner event, with awesome service, food, and some fun.

We went for a pre-show dinner and the server was great at helping us ensure we were done in time to make it to the show. We were seated at a less than stellar table and asked if we could take a booth a little further from the kitchen and door, but were told they were all reserved. Maybe the reservations were no shows bit those tables didn't fill up in the hour and a half we we there. The table we were stuck with actually gave a good view of the jazz duo that set up shortly after we arrived so it was not the worst place to sit.

The food was OK, we shared the calamari appetizer and then the chicken curry.  The calamari was a bit overcooked and the breading was falling off not awful, but not great either. The curry was flavorful, but I prefer a lot more vegetables. The vino was very pleasant, we ordered more to enjoy with a Mediterranean dip as we were still nibbly and had time (because the first course came so quickly). The dip was rather small and came with pita triangles that were doughy and unimaginative (would have been better if seasoned and toasted). Not a cheap smallish dinner, but it was a pleasant way to spend the time before we went to the show.

This is not a business that aims to satisfy a customer from the moment they walk in, to the moment they leave. 

Horrible time after time !!! I have been there multiples times months apart over the last 3 years, with hopes of great food and great service.  I had cold food once with slow and awkward service outside, and a bill still exceeding $100.00 for two of us with steak and wine.  Not at all would this be considered fine or even great dining based on the service and food, regardless of the price.

Our last visit we were confronted with extremely cold temperature inside, only to be advised that the heat was temporarily off when we had asked in light conversation.  We then had ordered a simple meal of a burger and a sandwich with fries and salad for lunch.  With empty glasses half hour later, we watched the server walk back and forth around us avoiding us each time.  When we flagged down this owner/server, he said the food was coming and gave some excuse for the delay...  Very disappointing considering we were only one of two tables seated in the entire restaurant.  40 minutes later we chose to walk away with no sight of food leaving the kitchen once in this time span, to which we had a clear view of.    

At this point, it was not about the food but the mere fact that this is not a business that aims to satisfy a customer from the moment they walk in, to the moment they leave.  I do give credit to the owner, who said he would cover the meal and asked us to stay. But, all hopes were lost and not to be regained by a free meal.  Just not worth it to wonder if our burger patty sat under a heat lamp for 30 minutes, or if the lettuce was left to wilt.


We walked down one block to a highly recommended burger joint and enjoyed our usual feast with typical prompt service. All in a matter of 25 minutes we ordered and ate our delicious burger and fries.  All of which could not be accomplished by a well established restaurant 1 block down.

Save the time and money, and keep driving when you think of stopping at Ric's Grill.

My kinda place. Not that I have been there much recently but it is still good. The food is good pub cuisine. The service has always been fast and friendly. Vlts always draw me in, along with the other games. Other than being thrown out once I have always enjoyed this neighbourhood pub

Brian and his staff are great.
His demeanor when he is busy is all work and as a business owner I get it. Don't let his (sometimes) gruffness put you off! He can fix anything.

I was craving a steak on Easter Sunday and found Ric's Grill online. The reviews were promising so I checked it out. The location is pretty nice, lofted ceilings and decent furniture.

There were 2 other customers in the whole restaurant so I had my pick of tables. I chose the lounge so I could watch The Masters on their small tube TV's.

I ordered a glass of Pinot Noir that was from Burgundy France and the New York Striploin rare. It came with a side of seasonal vegetables and herb roasted potatoes that were both well seasoned and tasty. The first bite of my steak felt a little cool in the middle but every bite afterwards was warm and perfectly rare.
